+# Bounded NLL scaleout on six available GPU lanes
+
+[Admission receipt](ADMISSION.json) binds this separately sealed twelve-fit sidecar, its source hashes, two-fold/three-new-seed-per-fold matrix and actual runtime properties. Initial real GPU profiles are running; this receipt does not claim the twelve scientific fits have started or completed. The original ten-fit cohort was healthy at sidecar admission.
+
+Observed base-cohort GPU0/1 utilization reached97-98% with two GRU workers each, while numeric Transformer cards2-7 generally showed0-14% and occasional higher samples. The sidecar assigns one matched cold-label NLL/WMSE pair to each of GPUs2-7, alongside its existing Transformer. This targets22 useful fits in parallel: three on each of six cards and two on the other two. GPU-busy percentage alone is not SM arithmetic efficiency; preserve completed sequence/update rates and profile timings when interpreting throughput. No batch/precision/source/optimizer change was made to the active fits.
+
+Every new arm uses the canonical GRU H256x2, full fitting sequences, strict FP32, three epochs and fixed ep2. WMSE and NLL share seed, fold, common auxiliaries and update policy. These are six added paired seed cells for the same mechanism; they are not six new scientific ideas. The official grader reports paired component uncertainty conditional on each fixed fit. Seed dispersion and public transfer remain separate limitations.
+
+The sidecar's original node wall began18:30:55UTC and still ends22:30:55UTC. Its service started19:06:15UTC with11350seconds, ending22:15:25UTC, then bounded stop and final publication. The sidecar has its own cgroup, receipt/log/profile/grade state, exclusive launch claim and no-restart timer. It never signals the original cohort or foreign jobs. The finalizer publishes its exact own-cgroup CUDA cleanup proof.
+
+[Launcher](prepare_scaleout.py) seals SIDEPLAN.json, verifies the actual base source/allocation before service start, and derives its timer from remaining original time. [Runner](scaleout.py) checks exact paired job identities and the immutable source seal, profiles serially within each pair, checks combined allocator peaks plus current resident memory, and admits only complete pairs. [Publisher](scaleout_publish.py) refreshes the PR37 comment initially, after paired completion and hourly, plus final cleanup. Failed and incomplete cells remain recorded.
+
+Canonical verified inputs and uniquely named scaleout run/prediction artifacts share the existing base nll_project. The fresh namespace guard rejects any preexisting run, profile, prediction cache or log for all twelve IDs; original ten-fit model paths are not reused or overwritten. The sidecar's own plan, logs, grades and publication receipts live at state/next4h-20261022-scaleout. The base PLAN/code remain unchanged. Initial review found the plan filename, remote import and grader paths inconsistent; those were corrected before the actual verifier and launch.

+"""Run twelve bounded cold-label NLL/WMSE fits under the parent node deadline."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import threading
+import time
+from concurrent import futures
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+ROOT = Path("/data/epanov_s/tabdata")
+BASE_PACKET = ROOT / "runtime/next4h-20261022-r2"
+BASE_STATE = ROOT / "state/next4h-20261022-r2"
+PACKET = ROOT / "runtime/next4h-20261022-scaleout"
+SIDE_PLAN = PACKET / "SIDEPLAN.json"
+STATE = ROOT / "state/next4h-20261022-scaleout"
+UNIT = "tabdata-next4h-20261022-scaleout.service"
+PROFILE_CUTOFF = 3600
+FIT_CUTOFF = 11100
+EVAL_CUTOFF = 12900
+GRADE_CUTOFF = 13140
+
+sys.path.insert(0, str(BASE_PACKET))
+
+import delivery  # noqa: E402
+
+
+def read(path: Path) -> Any:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+
+
+def write(path: Path, value: Any) -> None:
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    temp = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".tmp")
+    temp.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    temp.replace(path)
+
+
+def bind_delivery() -> None:
+    """Reuse the sealed operator while redirecting every owned receipt to side state."""
+    delivery.PACKET = BASE_PACKET
+    delivery.STATE = STATE
+    delivery.UNIT = UNIT
+
+
+def job_key(job: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[int, int]:
+    return int(job["fold"]), int(job["seed"])
+
+
+def expected_jobs() -> dict[tuple[int, int, str], tuple[int, list[int]]]:
+    expected: dict[tuple[int, int, str], tuple[int, list[int]]] = {}
+    for slot, (fold, seed, gpu) in enumerate(
+        [(0, 1301, 2), (0, 1302, 3), (0, 1303, 4), (2, 1401, 5), (2, 1402, 6), (2, 1403, 7)]
+    ):
+        for arm_index, arm in enumerate(("wmse", "nll")):
+            cpu_start = 64 + slot * 8 + arm_index * 4
+            expected[(fold, seed, arm)] = (gpu, list(range(cpu_start, cpu_start + 4)))
+    return expected
+
+
+def verify(base_plan: dict[str, Any], plan: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    """Bind both source cohorts and reject drift in the finite side allocation."""
+    expected_base = os.environ["TABDATA_BASE_PLAN_SHA256"].lower()
+    if delivery.sha(BASE_PACKET / "PLAN.json").lower() != expected_base:
+        raise ValueError("base cohort PLAN differs from separately supplied SHA256")
+    if plan.get("base_plan_sha256", "").lower() != expected_base:
+        raise ValueError("side plan is not bound to the active base plan")
+    expected_side = os.environ["TABDATA_SCALEOUT_PLAN_SHA256"].lower()
+    if delivery.sha(SIDE_PLAN).lower() != expected_side:
+        raise ValueError("side allocation differs from separately sealed plan hash")
+    base_start = read(BASE_STATE / "START.json")
+    if (
+        abs(float(plan.get("original_start_unix", -1)) - float(base_start["start_unix"])) > 1e-6
+        or abs(float(plan.get("deadline_unix", -1)) - float(base_start["deadline_unix"])) > 1e-6
+        or plan.get("unit") != UNIT
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("side plan changes the original deadline or service identity")
+    for filename, digest in plan.get("files", {}).items():
+        if delivery.sha(Path(filename)) != digest:
+            raise ValueError(f"side packet file hash mismatch: {filename}")
+
+    # Existing verifier checks the source packet and data mounts without launching work.
+    old_hash = os.environ.get("TABDATA_PLAN_SHA256")
+    os.environ["TABDATA_PLAN_SHA256"] = expected_base
+    try:
+        import cohort
+
+        cohort.verify(base_plan)
+    finally:
+        if old_hash is None:
+            os.environ.pop("TABDATA_PLAN_SHA256", None)
+        else:
+            os.environ["TABDATA_PLAN_SHA256"] = old_hash
+
+    expected = expected_jobs()
+    jobs = plan.get("jobs")
+    if not isinstance(jobs, list) or len(jobs) != 12:
+        raise ValueError("scaleout plan must contain exactly twelve new jobs")
+    seen: set[tuple[int, int, str]] = set()
+    ids: set[str] = set()
+    for job in jobs:
+        key = (int(job["fold"]), int(job["seed"]), str(job["arm"]))
+        if key not in expected or key in seen:
+            raise ValueError(f"unexpected or duplicate scaleout job: {key}")
+        gpu, cpus = expected[key]
+        expected_id = f"scaleout_f{key[0]}_s{key[1]}_{key[2]}"
+        if (
+            job.get("family") != "nll"
+            or job.get("id") != expected_id
+            or int(job.get("gpu_index", -1)) != gpu
+            or list(map(int, job.get("cpus", []))) != cpus
+            or not isinstance(job.get("gpu_uuid"), str)
+            or not job["gpu_uuid"].startswith("GPU-")
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(f"scaleout job violates frozen GPU/CPU/source allocation: {key}")
+        seen.add(key)
+        ids.add(expected_id)
+    if seen != set(expected):
+        raise ValueError("scaleout plan omits a declared matched arm")
+
+
+def require_fresh_outputs(jobs: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
+    """Share verified project inputs while refusing every existing side run/output."""
+    project = BASE_STATE / "nll_project"
+    for job in jobs:
+        for name in (job["id"], job["id"] + "_profile"):
+            if (project / "artifacts/runs" / name).exists():
+                raise FileExistsError("Existing scaleout run: " + name)
+            if list((project / "cache").glob("pred_" + name + "*")):
+                raise FileExistsError("Existing scaleout prediction: " + name)
+        if (STATE / "logs" / job["id"]).exists():
+            raise FileExistsError("Existing scaleout log: " + job["id"])
+
+
+def configure_delivery() -> None:
+    bind_delivery()
+    original_environment = delivery.environment
+
+    def side_environment(job: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> dict[str, str]:
+        env = original_environment(job)
+        env["WNN_PROJECT_ROOT"] = str(BASE_STATE / "nll_project")
+        # The four pinned CPUs per worker include the recipe's four data-loader workers.
+        env["OMP_NUM_THREADS"] = "2"
+        env["MKL_NUM_THREADS"] = "2"
+        return env
+
+    delivery.environment = side_environment
+
+
+def publish(final: bool = False) -> None:
+    """Make a bounded progress update; publication errors remain local evidence."""
+    stamp = str(time.time_ns())
+    deadline = min(read(STATE / "START.json")["start_unix"] + GRADE_CUTOFF, time.time() + 85)
+    try:
+        delivery.phase(
+            [
+                str(delivery.PYTHON),
+                str(PACKET / "scaleout_publish.py"),
+                *(["--final"] if final else []),
+            ],
+            cwd=ROOT,
+            env=delivery.environment(),
+            log=STATE / "publication_logs" / f"{stamp}.log",
+            deadline=deadline,
+        )
+    except Exception as error:
+        write(STATE / "publication_logs" / f"{stamp}.failure.json", {"error": repr(error)})
+
+
+def run_profile(job: dict[str, Any], deadline: float) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    result = delivery.run_job_phase(job, "profile", deadline)
+    approved = delivery.approve_profile(job, result)
+    write(STATE / "profiles" / f"{job['id']}.json", approved)
+    return approved
+
+
+def profile_pair(jobs: list[dict[str, Any]], deadline: float) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Profile each paired arm serially on its GPU, then reserve aggregate headroom."""
+    results: dict[str, Any] = {}
+    errors: dict[str, str] = {}
+    for job in sorted(jobs, key=lambda item: item["arm"]):
+        try:
+            results[job["id"]] = run_profile(job, deadline)
+        except Exception as error:
+            errors[job["id"]] = repr(error)
+            break
+    if errors or len(results) != 2:
+        return {"passed": False, "profiles": results, "errors": errors}
+
+    gpu_uuid = jobs[0]["gpu_uuid"]
+    observation = subprocess.check_output(
+        [
+            "nvidia-smi",
+            "-i",
+            gpu_uuid,
+            "--query-gpu=uuid,memory.used,memory.free,memory.total",
+            "--format=csv,noheader,nounits",
+        ],
+        text=True,
+        timeout=10,
+    ).strip()
+    fields = [value.strip() for value in observation.split(",")]
+    if fields[0] != gpu_uuid:
+        return {"passed": False, "profiles": results, "errors": {"gpu": "UUID mismatch"}}
+    used, free, total = map(float, fields[1:])
+    reserved = sum(float(results[j["id"]]["memory"]["peak_reserved_bytes"]) for j in jobs)
+    # Profile processes have exited; current used memory captures co-resident base fits.
+    used_bytes = used * 1024 * 1024
+    free_bytes = free * 1024 * 1024
+    total_bytes = total * 1024 * 1024
+    if used_bytes + reserved >= 0.90 * total_bytes or reserved > free_bytes:
+        return {
+            "passed": False,
+            "profiles": results,
+            "errors": {
+                "aggregate_memory": "paired measured peaks plus observed residents fail 90%/free-memory gate"
+            },
+            "gpu_observation": observation,
+            "paired_peak_reserved_bytes": reserved,
+        }
+    return {
+        "passed": True,
+        "profiles": results,
+        "gpu_observation": observation,
+        "paired_peak_reserved_bytes": reserved,
+        "co_resident_memory_used_bytes": used_bytes,
+    }
+
+
+def fit(job: dict[str, Any], start: float) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    record: dict[str, Any] = {"job": job, "phase": "fitting", "started_unix": time.time()}
+    path = STATE / "jobs" / f"{job['id']}.json"
+    write(path, record)
+    try:
+        record["fit"] = delivery.run_job_phase(job, "fit", start + FIT_CUTOFF)
+        record["phase"] = "fit_complete"
+        write(path, record)
+        record["evaluation"] = delivery.run_job_phase(job, "evaluate", start + EVAL_CUTOFF)
+        record["phase"] = "evaluated"
+    except Exception as error:
+        record["phase"] = "failed_or_partial"
+        record["error"] = repr(error)
+    record["finished_unix"] = time.time()
+    write(path, record)
+    return record
+
+
+def grade_pairs(jobs: list[dict[str, Any]], start: float) -> None:
+    by_pair: dict[tuple[int, int], dict[str, dict[str, Any]]] = {}
+    for job in jobs:
+        path = STATE / "jobs" / f"{job['id']}.json"
+        if path.exists():
+            record = read(path)
+            by_pair.setdefault(job_key(job), {})[job["arm"]] = record
+    for (fold, seed), arms in sorted(by_pair.items()):
+        output = STATE / "grades" / f"pair_f{fold}_s{seed}.json"
+        failure = STATE / "grades" / f"pair_f{fold}_s{seed}.failure.json"
+        if output.exists() or failure.exists() or set(arms) != {"nll", "wmse"}:
+            continue
+        if any(arms[arm].get("phase") != "evaluated" for arm in ("nll", "wmse")):
+            continue
+        nll = f"scaleout_f{fold}_s{seed}_nll@ep2"
+        wmse = f"scaleout_f{fold}_s{seed}_wmse@ep2"
+        stamp = str(time.time_ns())
+        try:
+            delivery.phase(
+                [
+                    str(delivery.PYTHON),
+                    str(BASE_PACKET / "nll_grade.py"),
+                    "--project-root",
+                    str(BASE_STATE / "nll_project"),
+                    "--split-manifest",
+                    str(ROOT / "splits" / f"fold{fold}.json"),
+                    "--candidate",
+                    nll,
+                    "--control",
+                    wmse,
+                    "--output",
+                    str(output),
+                    "--plan",
+                    str(SIDE_PLAN),
+                    "--plan-sha256",
+                    os.environ["TABDATA_SCALEOUT_PLAN_SHA256"],
+                ],
+                cwd=PACKET,
+                env=delivery.environment(),
+                log=STATE / "grade_logs" / f"f{fold}_s{seed}_{stamp}.log",
+                deadline=start + GRADE_CUTOFF,
+            )
+        except Exception as error:
+            write(STATE / "grades" / f"pair_f{fold}_s{seed}.failure.json", {"error": repr(error)})
+        publish()
+
+
+def monitor(stop: threading.Event) -> None:
+    next_publish = time.time() + 3600
+    while not stop.wait(30):
+        try:
+            snapshot = subprocess.check_output(
+                [
+                    "nvidia-smi",
+                    "--query-gpu=index,uuid,memory.used,memory.free,utilization.gpu",
+                    "--format=csv,noheader,nounits",
+                ],
+                text=True,
+                timeout=10,
+            )
+            with (STATE / "gpu_samples.jsonl").open("a", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
+                stream.write(json.dumps({"time_unix": time.time(), "gpu_csv": snapshot}) + "\n")
+            if time.time() >= next_publish:
+                publish()
+                next_publish = time.time() + 3600
+        except Exception as error:
+            write(STATE / "MONITOR_ERROR.json", {"error": repr(error), "time_unix": time.time()})
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    base_plan = read(BASE_PACKET / "PLAN.json")
+    plan = read(SIDE_PLAN)
+    verify(base_plan, plan)
+    require_fresh_outputs(plan["jobs"])
+    configure_delivery()
+    start_record = read(BASE_STATE / "START.json")
+    start = float(start_record["start_unix"])
+    if os.environ.get("TABDATA_SERVICE_UNIT") != UNIT:
+        raise ValueError("scaleout service identity environment is missing or mismatched")
+    cgroup = Path("/proc/self/cgroup").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    if UNIT not in cgroup:
+        raise ValueError("scaleout process is not inside its dedicated systemd unit")
+    STATE.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    try:
+        owner_fd = os.open(STATE / "OWNER.lock", os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_WRONLY, 0o600)
+    except FileExistsError as error:
+        raise RuntimeError("scaleout one-shot has already been claimed") from error
+    with os.fdopen(owner_fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as owner:
+        owner.write(f"pid={os.getpid()}\nunit={UNIT}\n")
+    if time.time() >= start + FIT_CUTOFF:
+        raise TimeoutError("Scaleout arrived after the common fit-admission cutoff")
+    if (STATE / "START.json").exists():
+        raise FileExistsError("Scaleout state already contains a start receipt")
+    write(
+        STATE / "START.json",
+        {
+            "start_unix": start,
+            "sidecar_started_unix": time.time(),
+            "deadline_unix": float(start_record["deadline_unix"]),
+            "service": UNIT,
+            "base_plan_sha256": os.environ["TABDATA_BASE_PLAN_SHA256"],
+            "scaleout_plan_sha256": os.environ["TABDATA_SCALEOUT_PLAN_SHA256"],
+            "partial_endpoints_allowed": True,
+        },
+    )
+    write(
+        STATE / "PLAN_BINDING.json",
+        {
+            "base_plan": os.environ["TABDATA_BASE_PLAN_SHA256"],
+            "scaleout_plan": os.environ["TABDATA_SCALEOUT_PLAN_SHA256"],
+        },
+    )
+    stop = threading.Event()
+    monitor_thread = threading.Thread(target=monitor, args=(stop,), daemon=True)
+    monitor_thread.start()
+    jobs = plan["jobs"]
+    publish()
+
+    groups: dict[tuple[int, int], list[dict[str, Any]]] = {}
+    for job in jobs:
+        groups.setdefault(job_key(job), []).append(job)
+    profile_results: dict[tuple[int, int], dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    profile_deadline = start + PROFILE_CUTOFF
+    with futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=6) as pool:
+        running = {
+            pool.submit(profile_pair, pair, profile_deadline): key for key, pair in groups.items()
+        }
+        for completed in futures.as_completed(running):
+            key = running[completed]
+            try:
+                profile_results[key] = completed.result()
+            except Exception as error:
+                profile_results[key] = {"passed": False, "errors": {"worker": repr(error)}}
+    write(
+        STATE / "PROFILES.json",
+        {f"f{fold}_s{seed}": value for (fold, seed), value in sorted(profile_results.items())},
+    )
+    admitted_pairs = [key for key, result in profile_results.items() if result.get("passed")]
+    admitted_ids = [job["id"] for job in jobs if job_key(job) in admitted_pairs]
+    write(
+        STATE / "ADMISSION.json",
+        {
+            "admitted_pairs": [f"f{fold}_s{seed}" for fold, seed in sorted(admitted_pairs)],
+            "admitted_jobs": admitted_ids,
+            "failed_pairs": {

+            "fit_cutoff_unix": start + FIT_CUTOFF,

+    )

+            running = {pool.submit(fit, job, start): job for job in admitted}
+            for completed in futures.as_completed(running):

+                # This grades/publishes a pair as soon as both arms have completed.
+                grade_pairs(admitted, start)
+    stop.set()
+    monitor_thread.join(timeout=5)
+    write(
+        STATE / "COMPLETE.json", {"finished_unix": time.time(), "jobs": [j["id"] for j in admitted]}
+    )
+    publish()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Publish bounded PR37 scaleout status and prove only this cgroup's CUDA clients."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import fcntl
+import hashlib
+import json
+import sys
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+ROOT = Path("/data/epanov_s/tabdata")
+PACKET = ROOT / "runtime/next4h-20261022-scaleout"
+SIDE_PLAN = PACKET / "SIDEPLAN.json"
+BASE_PACKET = ROOT / "runtime/next4h-20261022-r2"
+BASE_STATE = ROOT / "state/next4h-20261022-r2"
+STATE = ROOT / "state/next4h-20261022-scaleout"
+UNIT = "tabdata-next4h-20261022-scaleout.service"
+MARKER = "<!-- tabdata-scaleout-20261022:PR37 -->"
+
+
+def read(path: Path) -> Any:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+
+
+def write(path: Path, value: Any) -> None:
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    temp = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".tmp")
+    temp.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    temp.replace(path)
+
+
+def progress(job: dict[str, Any], side: bool) -> str:
+    if side:
+        job_file = STATE / "jobs" / f"{job['id']}.json"
+        if job_file.exists():
+            record = read(job_file)
+            phase = record.get("phase", "unknown")
+        else:
+            phase = "profiled/admission or not yet started"
+        run_root = BASE_STATE / "nll_project/artifacts/runs" / job["id"]
+    else:
+        job_file = BASE_STATE / "jobs" / f"{job['id']}.json"
+        record = read(job_file) if job_file.exists() else {}
+        phase = record.get("phase", "not yet started")
+        if job.get("family") == "nll":
+            run_root = BASE_STATE / "nll_project/artifacts/runs" / job["id"]
+        else:
+            run_root = BASE_STATE / "numeric/runs_r2_e3" / f"f{job['fold']}_{job['arm']}"
+
+    history = run_root / "history.json"
+    if history.exists():
+        try:
+            return f"{phase}; {len(read(history))}/3 epoch records"
+        except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError):
+            pass
+    for filename in ("rank0.jsonl", "metrics.jsonl"):
+        path = run_root / filename
+        if path.exists():
+            try:
+                rows = [
+                    line for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if line.strip()
+                ]
+                if rows:
+                    last = json.loads(rows[-1])
+                    step = last.get("global_step", last.get("step", last.get("update", "?")))
+                    return f"{phase}; {len(rows)} rank0/metric records, last step {step}"
+            except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError):
+                return f"{phase}; progress log present"
+    return f"{phase}; no epoch/update receipt yet"
+
+
+def gpu_proof(final: bool) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    import subprocess
+
+    output = subprocess.check_output(
+        [
+            "nvidia-smi",
+            "--query-compute-apps=pid,gpu_uuid,used_gpu_memory",
+            "--format=csv,noheader",
+        ],
+        text=True,
+        timeout=10,
+    )
+    owned = []
+    for row in output.splitlines():
+        try:
+            pid = int(row.split(",", 1)[0].strip())
+            group = Path(f"/proc/{pid}/cgroup").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+        except (ValueError, OSError):
+            continue
+        if UNIT in group:
+            owned.append(row)
+    return {"observed_unix": time.time(), "owned_cuda_clients": owned, "final": final}
+
+
+def report(final: bool) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "runtime/github-reporting-v1/code"))
+    from github_api import GitHub, read_token
+
+    config = read(ROOT / "runtime/github-reporting-v1/CONFIG.json")
+    api = GitHub(read_token(Path(config["token_file"])), request_limit=8)
+    if api.request("GET", "/user")["login"] != "SemyonEpanov":
+        raise ValueError("Unexpected GitHub publisher identity")
+    proof = gpu_proof(final)
+    plan = read(SIDE_PLAN)
+    start = read(STATE / "START.json")
+    base_plan = read(BASE_PACKET / "PLAN.json")
+    lines = [
+        MARKER,
+        "### Additional cold-label NLL scaleout — " + ("final" if final else "progress update"),
+        "",
+        f"Side-plan SHA256 `{hashlib.sha256(SIDE_PLAN.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}`; base-plan SHA256 `{start['base_plan_sha256']}`.",
+        "This is a new cold-label adaptation, not the historical warm-teacher result. Each matched NLL/WMSE pair uses the same fresh-init seed and source-bound fold; 3 strict-FP32 epochs, fixed epoch 2, canonical 25-output head, full frozen training membership, and unchanged official grader.",
+        f"The original node deadline remains `{start['deadline_unix']:.3f}`; profiles +3600s, fit +11100s, evaluation +12900s, grade +13140s. Scaleout service `{UNIT}` owns only its own CUDA work.",
+        "",
+        "#### Added scaleout pairs",
+        "| Pair | GPU | WMSE progress | NLL progress | Grade |",
+        "|---|---:|---|---|---|",
+    ]
+    pairs: dict[tuple[int, int], dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    for job in plan["jobs"]:
+        pairs.setdefault((int(job["fold"]), int(job["seed"])), {})[job["arm"]] = job
+    for (fold, seed), arms in sorted(pairs.items()):
+        gpu = int(arms["nll"]["gpu_index"])
+        wmse = progress(arms["wmse"], True)
+        nll = progress(arms["nll"], True)
+        grade_path = STATE / "grades" / f"pair_f{fold}_s{seed}.json"
+        grade = "pending"
+        if grade_path.exists():
+            value = read(grade_path)
+            panel = value["panels"][0]
+            grade = f"ΔWP {panel['paired_component_bootstrap']['mean_diff']:.6g}"
+        lines.append(f"| F{fold}/s{seed} | {gpu} | {wmse} | {nll} | {grade} |")
+    lines += [
+        "",
+        "#### Original cohort progress context",
+        "The original cohort continues independently under its own service; the rows below are read-only progress observations and are not scaleout fits.",
+        "| Cell | Phase / last observed progress |",
+        "|---|---|",
+    ]
+    for job in base_plan["jobs"]:
+        lines.append(f"| {job['id']} | {progress(job, False)} |")
+    lines += [
+        "",
+        f"Owned scaleout CUDA clients at observation: {len(proof['owned_cuda_clients'])}.",
+        "Partial epochs are progress only; paired grades condition on these fixed fits and their component bootstrap does not estimate seed uncertainty. No public-score claim.",
+        f"Logs, checkpoints, predictions, hashes, grades and cleanup receipt remain in `{STATE}`; no credentials, weights, or datasets are posted.",
+    ]
+    if final and not proof["owned_cuda_clients"]:
+        lines += [
+            "",
+            "Terminal cleanup proof: no CUDA clients remain in this scaleout systemd cgroup.",
+        ]
+    body = "\n".join(lines)
+    outbox = STATE / "PR37_SCALEOUT_LATEST.md"
+    outbox.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    outbox.write_text(body, encoding="utf-8")
+    previous = [
+        comment
+        for comment in api.comments(37)
+        if MARKER in comment.get("body", "")
+        and comment.get("user", {}).get("login") == "SemyonEpanov"
+    ]
+    response = api.patch(previous[-1]["id"], body) if previous else api.post(37, body)
+    result = {
+        "url": response["html_url"],
+        "body_sha256": hashlib.sha256(body.encode()).hexdigest(),
+        "proof": proof,
+        "created_unix": time.time(),
+    }
+    write(STATE / "PUBLICATION_LATEST.json", result)
+    if final:
+        write(STATE / "FINAL_GPU_PROOF.json", proof)
+    return result
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--final", action="store_true")
+    options = parser.parse_args()
+    with (STATE / "publication.lock").open("a") as lock:
+        fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
+        print(json.dumps(report(options.final)))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Freeze mounted inputs, finite GPU allocation and every executable file."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+import subprocess
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from delivery import PACKET, ROOT, STATE, UNIT, read, sha, write
+
+
+def link(path: Path, target: Path) -> None:
+    """Create only a new owned link, rejecting accidental path replacement."""
+    if path.exists() or path.is_symlink():
+        if not path.is_symlink() or path.resolve() != target.resolve():
+            raise ValueError(f"Unexpected existing path: {path}")
+    else:
+        path.symlink_to(target, target_is_directory=target.is_dir())
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    """Prepare read-only input mounts and seal one nonrenewable cohort."""
+    if (PACKET / "PLAN.json").exists() or (STATE / "START.json").exists():
+        raise FileExistsError("Existing frozen allocation must not be replaced")
+    if "29 passed" not in (STATE / "numeric-tests-rerun.log").read_text():
+        raise ValueError("Numeric receiver tests have not passed")
+    project = STATE / "nll_project"
+    (project / "cache").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    (project / "artifacts/runs").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    link(project / "datasets", ROOT / "data/datasets")
+    link(project / "splits", ROOT / "splits")
+    link(project / "src", PACKET / "sources/nll/src")
+    link(project / "scripts", PACKET / "sources/nll/scripts")
+    for source in (ROOT / "data/cache").glob("*.npz"):
+        link(project / "cache" / source.name, source)
+    rows = subprocess.check_output(
+        [
+            "nvidia-smi",
+            "--query-gpu=index,uuid,name,memory.free,memory.total",
+            "--format=csv,noheader,nounits",
+        ],
+        text=True,
+        timeout=10,
+    ).splitlines()
+    devices = [[cell.strip() for cell in row.split(",")] for row in rows]
+    if len(devices) != 8 or any("B300" not in row[2] for row in devices):
+        raise ValueError("Expected eight authorized B300 GPUs")
+    processes = subprocess.check_output(
+        ["nvidia-smi", "--query-compute-apps=pid,gpu_uuid", "--format=csv,noheader"],
+        text=True,
+        timeout=10,
+    )
+    if processes.strip():
+        raise ValueError("Node availability changed; reassess foreign workload before allocation")
+    available = sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))
+    if len(available) < 24:
+        raise ValueError("Insufficient CPU lanes for bounded independent data loading")
+    jobs = []
+    for fold, seed in ((0, 1001), (2, 1002)):
+        for arm in ("raw_events", "uniform16", "quantile16"):
+            gpu = 2 + len(jobs)
+            jobs.append(
+                {
+                    "id": f"numeric_f{fold}_{arm}",
+                    "family": "numeric",
+                    "fold": fold,
+                    "seed": seed,
+                    "arm": arm,
+                    "gpu_index": gpu,
+                }
+            )
+    for fold, seed, gpu in ((0, 1201, 0), (2, 1202, 1)):
+        for arm in ("wmse", "nll"):
+            jobs.append(
+                {
+                    "id": f"nll_f{fold}_s{seed}_{arm}",
+                    "family": "nll",
+                    "fold": fold,
+                    "seed": seed,
+                    "arm": arm,
+                    "gpu_index": gpu,
+                }
+            )
+    for index, job in enumerate(jobs):
+        job["gpu_uuid"] = next(row[1] for row in devices if int(row[0]) == job["gpu_index"])
+        job["cpus"] = available[index * 2 : index * 2 + 2]
+    files = {
+        str(path): sha(path)
+        for path in PACKET.rglob("*")
+        if path.is_file()
+        and path.suffix in {".py", ".json", ".toml", ".lock"}
+        and "__pycache__" not in path.parts
+        and path.name != "PLAN.json"
+    }
+    for fold in (0, 2):
+        path = ROOT / "splits" / f"fold{fold}.json"
+        files[str(path)] = sha(path)
+    write(
+        PACKET / "PLAN.json",
+        {
+            "schema": "tabdata-next4h-r2.v1",
+            "unit": UNIT,
+            "max_wall_seconds": 14400,
+            "runtime_max_seconds": 13500,
+            "stop_grace_seconds": 120,
+            "finalizer_timeout_seconds": 110,
+            "conservative_all_in_upper_seconds": 13740,
+            "fit_cutoff_seconds": 11100,
+            "export_cutoff_seconds": 12900,
+            "grade_cutoff_seconds": 13140,
+            "epochs": 3,
+            "fixed_epoch": 2,
+            "partial_progress_allowed": True,
+            "partial_is_quality_endpoint": False,
+            "jobs": jobs,
+            "files": files,
+            "inputs": read(STATE / "INPUTS.json"),
+            "baseline_gpu_rows": devices,
+            "mask_readout": "not admitted: exact parent assets absent; zero substitution",
+            "source_commits": {
+                "numeric": "20faaa1abddb79f342a3b66ba0e5623a15c65a25",
+                "nll": "6577b88e",
+                "mask": "eceb95c0536bf03ff260379e8f86a52cb4f5d56b",
+            },
+            "new_fits": 10,

+

This adds eight matched NLL/WMSE cells to the existing H256 experiment, bringing observed concurrency to38. On GPUs0/1 there are four GRUs each; GPUs2-7 each have four GRUs plus one numeric Transformer. The recorded97-98% GPU-busy values do not establish peak arithmetic throughput.

Every H512 cell matches an already running H256 fold/seed. NLL versus WMSE at H512 is the primary within-width comparison; H256-to-H512 effects and their interaction are exploratory secondary comparisons. +"""Run sixteen bounded H512 cold-label NLL/WMSE fits under the parent node deadline."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import threading
+import time
+from concurrent import futures
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+ROOT = Path("/data/epanov_s/tabdata")
+BASE_PACKET = ROOT / "runtime/next4h-20261022-r2"
+BASE_STATE = ROOT / "state/next4h-20261022-r2"
+PACKET = ROOT / "runtime/next4h-20261022-wide"
+SIDE_PLAN = PACKET / "SIDEPLAN.json"
+STATE = ROOT / "state/next4h-20261022-wide"
+UNIT = "tabdata-next4h-20261022-wide.service"
+PROFILE_CUTOFF = 3600
+FIT_CUTOFF = 11100
+EVAL_CUTOFF = 12900
+GRADE_CUTOFF = 13140
+
+sys.path.insert(0, str(BASE_PACKET))
+
+import delivery  # noqa: E402
+
+
+def read(path: Path) -> Any:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+
+
+def write(path: Path, value: Any) -> None:
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    temp = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".tmp")
+    temp.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    temp.replace(path)
+
+
+def bind_delivery() -> None:
+    """Reuse the sealed operator while redirecting every owned receipt to side state."""
+    delivery.PACKET = BASE_PACKET
+    delivery.STATE = STATE
+    delivery.UNIT = UNIT
+
+
+def job_key(job: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[int, int]:
+    return int(job["fold"]), int(job["seed"])
+
+
+def expected_jobs() -> dict[tuple[int, int, str], tuple[int, list[int]]]:
+    expected: dict[tuple[int, int, str], tuple[int, list[int]]] = {}
+    for slot, (fold, seed, gpu) in enumerate(
+        [
+            (0, 1201, 0),
+            (2, 1202, 1),
+            (0, 1301, 2),
+            (0, 1302, 3),
+            (0, 1303, 4),
+            (2, 1401, 5),
+            (2, 1402, 6),
+            (2, 1403, 7),
+        ]
+    ):
+        for arm_index, arm in enumerate(("wmse", "nll")):
+            cpu_start = 128 + slot * 16 + arm_index * 8
+            expected[(fold, seed, arm)] = (gpu, list(range(cpu_start, cpu_start + 8)))
+    return expected
+
+
+def verify(base_plan: dict[str, Any], plan: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    """Bind both source cohorts and reject drift in the finite side allocation."""
+    expected_base = os.environ["TABDATA_BASE_PLAN_SHA256"].lower()
+    if delivery.sha(BASE_PACKET / "PLAN.json").lower() != expected_base:
+        raise ValueError("base cohort PLAN differs from separately supplied SHA256")
+    if plan.get("base_plan_sha256", "").lower() != expected_base:
+        raise ValueError("side plan is not bound to the active base plan")
+    expected_side = os.environ["TABDATA_WIDE_PLAN_SHA256"].lower()
+    if delivery.sha(SIDE_PLAN).lower() != expected_side:
+        raise ValueError("side allocation differs from separately sealed plan hash")
+    base_start = read(BASE_STATE / "START.json")
+    if (
+        abs(float(plan.get("original_start_unix", -1)) - float(base_start["start_unix"])) > 1e-6
+        or abs(float(plan.get("deadline_unix", -1)) - float(base_start["deadline_unix"])) > 1e-6
+        or plan.get("unit") != UNIT
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("side plan changes the original deadline or service identity")
+    for filename, digest in plan.get("files", {}).items():
+        if delivery.sha(Path(filename)) != digest:
+            raise ValueError(f"side packet file hash mismatch: {filename}")
+
+    # Existing verifier checks the source packet and data mounts without launching work.
+    old_hash = os.environ.get("TABDATA_PLAN_SHA256")
+    os.environ["TABDATA_PLAN_SHA256"] = expected_base
+    try:
+        import cohort
+
+        cohort.verify(base_plan)
+    finally:
+        if old_hash is None:
+            os.environ.pop("TABDATA_PLAN_SHA256", None)
+        else:
+            os.environ["TABDATA_PLAN_SHA256"] = old_hash
+
+    if plan.get("hidden") != 512:
+        raise ValueError("Wide recipe requires hidden=512")
+    expected = expected_jobs()
+    visible_cpus = os.sched_getaffinity(0)
+    devices = {job["gpu_index"]: job["gpu_uuid"] for job in base_plan["jobs"]}
+    jobs = plan.get("jobs")
+    if not isinstance(jobs, list) or len(jobs) != 16:
+        raise ValueError("wide plan must contain exactly sixteen new jobs")
+    seen: set[tuple[int, int, str]] = set()
+    ids: set[str] = set()
+    for job in jobs:
+        key = (int(job["fold"]), int(job["seed"]), str(job["arm"]))
+        if key not in expected or key in seen:
+            raise ValueError(f"unexpected or duplicate wide job: {key}")
+        gpu, cpus = expected[key]
+        expected_id = f"wide_f{key[0]}_s{key[1]}_{key[2]}"
+        if (
+            job.get("family") != "nll"
+            or job.get("id") != expected_id
+            or int(job.get("gpu_index", -1)) != gpu
+            or list(map(int, job.get("cpus", []))) != cpus
+            or not isinstance(job.get("gpu_uuid"), str)
+            or not job["gpu_uuid"].startswith("GPU-")
+            or job["gpu_uuid"] != devices[gpu]
+            or not set(cpus).issubset(visible_cpus)
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(f"wide job violates frozen GPU/CPU/source allocation: {key}")
+        seen.add(key)
+        ids.add(expected_id)
+    if seen != set(expected):
+        raise ValueError("wide plan omits a declared matched arm")
+
+
+def require_fresh_outputs(jobs: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
+    """Share verified project inputs while refusing every existing side run/output."""
+    project = BASE_STATE / "nll_project"
+    for job in jobs:
+        for name in (job["id"], job["id"] + "_profile"):
+            if (project / "artifacts/runs" / name).exists():
+                raise FileExistsError("Existing wide run: " + name)
+            if list((project / "cache").glob("pred_" + name + "*")):
+                raise FileExistsError("Existing wide prediction: " + name)
+        if (STATE / "logs" / job["id"]).exists():
+            raise FileExistsError("Existing wide log: " + job["id"])
+
+
+def configure_delivery() -> None:
+    bind_delivery()
+    original_environment = delivery.environment
+
+    def side_environment(job: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> dict[str, str]:
+        env = original_environment(job)
+        env["WNN_PROJECT_ROOT"] = str(BASE_STATE / "nll_project")
+        # The eight pinned CPUs per worker include the recipe's four data-loader workers.
+        env["OMP_NUM_THREADS"] = "2"
+        env["MKL_NUM_THREADS"] = "2"
+        return env
+
+    delivery.environment = side_environment
+    original_command = delivery.nll_command
+
+    def wide_command(job: dict[str, Any], stage: str) -> list[str]:
+        command = original_command(job, stage)
+        if stage != "evaluate":
+            command[command.index("--hidden") + 1] = "512"

+
+    delivery.nll_command = wide_command
+
+
+def publish(final: bool = False) -> None:
+    """Make a bounded progress update; publication errors remain local evidence."""
+    stamp = str(time.time_ns())
+    deadline = min(read(STATE / "START.json")["start_unix"] + GRADE_CUTOFF, time.time() + 85)
+    try:
+        delivery.phase(
+            [
+                str(delivery.PYTHON),
+                str(PACKET / "wide_publish.py"),
+                *(["--final"] if final else []),
+            ],
+            cwd=ROOT,

+
+def run_profile(job: dict[str, Any], deadline: float) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    result = delivery.run_job_phase(job, "profile", deadline)
+    approved = delivery.approve_profile(job, result)
+    write(STATE / "profiles" / f"{job['id']}.json", approved)
+    return approved
+
+
+def profile_pair(jobs: list[dict[str, Any]], deadline: float) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Profile each paired arm serially on its GPU, then reserve aggregate headroom."""
+    results: dict[str, Any] = {}
+    errors: dict[str, str] = {}
+    for job in sorted(jobs, key=lambda item: item["arm"]):
+        try:
+            results[job["id"]] = run_profile(job, deadline)
+        except Exception as error:
+            errors[job["id"]] = repr(error)
+            break
+    if errors or len(results) != 2:
+        return {"passed": False, "profiles": results, "errors": errors}
+
+    gpu_uuid = jobs[0]["gpu_uuid"]
+    observation = subprocess.check_output(
+        [
+            "nvidia-smi",
+            "-i",
+            gpu_uuid,
+            "--query-gpu=uuid,memory.used,memory.free,memory.total",
+            "--format=csv,noheader,nounits",
+        ],
+        text=True,
+        timeout=10,
+    ).strip()
+    fields = [value.strip() for value in observation.split(",")]
+    if fields[0] != gpu_uuid:
+        return {"passed": False, "profiles": results, "errors": {"gpu": "UUID mismatch"}}
+    used, free, total = map(float, fields[1:])
+    reserved = sum(float(results[j["id"]]["memory"]["peak_reserved_bytes"]) for j in jobs)
+    # Profile processes have exited; current used memory captures co-resident base fits.
+    used_bytes = used * 1024 * 1024
+    free_bytes = free * 1024 * 1024
+    total_bytes = total * 1024 * 1024
+    if used_bytes + reserved >= 0.90 * total_bytes or reserved > free_bytes:
+        return {
+            "passed": False,
+            "profiles": results,
+            "errors": {
+                "aggregate_memory": "paired measured peaks plus observed residents fail 90%/free-memory gate"
+            },
+            "gpu_observation": observation,
+            "paired_peak_reserved_bytes": reserved,
+        }
+    return {
+        "passed": True,
+        "profiles": results,
+        "gpu_observation": observation,
+        "paired_peak_reserved_bytes": reserved,
+        "co_resident_memory_used_bytes": used_bytes,
+    }
+
+
+def fit(job: dict[str, Any], start: float) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    record: dict[str, Any] = {"job": job, "phase": "fitting", "started_unix": time.time()}
+    path = STATE / "jobs" / f"{job['id']}.json"
+    write(path, record)
+    try:
+        record["fit"] = delivery.run_job_phase(job, "fit", start + FIT_CUTOFF)
+        record["phase"] = "fit_complete"
+        write(path, record)
+        record["evaluation"] = delivery.run_job_phase(job, "evaluate", start + EVAL_CUTOFF)
+        record["phase"] = "evaluated"
+    except Exception as error:
+        record["phase"] = "failed_or_partial"

+    write(path, record)

+
+def grade_pairs(jobs: list[dict[str, Any]], start: float) -> None:
+    by_pair: dict[tuple[int, int], dict[str, dict[str, Any]]] = {}
+    for job in jobs:
+        path = STATE / "jobs" / f"{job['id']}.json"
+        if path.exists():
+            record = read(path)
+            by_pair.setdefault(job_key(job), {})[job["arm"]] = record

+

+

+
+ROOT = Path("/data/epanov_s/tabdata")

+
+
+def read(path: Path) -> Any:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+
+
+def write(path: Path, value: Any) -> None:
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    temp = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".tmp")
+    temp.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    temp.replace(path)
+
+
+def progress(job: dict[str, Any], side: bool) -> str:
+    if side:
+        job_file = STATE / "jobs" / f"{job['id']}.json"
+        if job_file.exists():
+            record = read(job_file)
+            phase = record.get("phase", "unknown")
+        else:
+            phase = "profiled/admission or not yet started"
+        run_root = BASE_STATE / "nll_project/artifacts/runs" / job["id"]
+    else:
+        job_file = BASE_STATE / "jobs" / f"{job['id']}.json"
+        record = read(job_file) if job_file.exists() else {}
+        phase = record.get("phase", "not yet started")
+        if job.get("family") == "nll":
+            run_root = BASE_STATE / "nll_project/artifacts/runs" / job["id"]
+        else:
+            run_root = BASE_STATE / "numeric/runs_r2_e3" / f"f{job['fold']}_{job['arm']}"
+
+    history = run_root / "history.json"
+    if history.exists():
+        try:
+            return f"{phase}; {len(read(history))}/3 epoch records"
+        except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError):
+            pass
+    for path in [*run_root.glob("metrics.jsonl"), *run_root.rglob("rank0.jsonl")]:
+        if path.exists():
+            try:
+                rows = [
+                    line for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if line.strip()
+                ]
+                if rows:
+                    last = json.loads(rows[-1])

+                    return f"{phase}; {len(rows)} rank0/metric records, last step {step}"

+
+    output = subprocess.check_output(

+            "nvidia-smi",

+
+

Each matched NLL/WMSE pair uses the same fresh-init seed and source-bound fold; 3 strict-FP32 epochs, fixed epoch 2, H512x2 GRU and canonical 25-output head, full frozen training membership, and unchanged official grader.",

+        "",

+# [Experiment] Cold-label mean/logvariance NLL on full GRU
+
+1. **Status, lineage and owner.** Local implementation and packet only; not published and not launched. Branch: `experiment/b300-nll-labels-20261022`, based on `68ff682977b822f38351aac0f621146f5f13b440`, the source child used by the prior warm NLL result. This is a NEW cold-label objective adaptation, not a faithful replication of the warm MainT3 experiment. H/E IDs and owner remain to be assigned by the coordinating campaign. No parent checkpoint, teacher, cache, or learned preprocessing artifact is used.
+
+2. **Why it should work.** A clipped-label weighted Gaussian NLL may learn useful scale-dependent errors while retaining the same mean outputs and score-facing predictions as WMSE. The new path uses the observed clipped labels, `w = abs(clipped_label) * main_valid`, and `w * (exp(-clamp(logvar,-4,4)) * (mean-target)^2 + clamp(logvar,-4,4))`, divided by `max(sum(w), 1e-8)`. The strongest alternative is that label noise makes variance fitting distract the shared representation; the matched WMSE arm distinguishes objective value from model size and initialization.
+
+   Existing evidence is mixed and narrow. A prior warm/teacher NLL fit completed six epochs without nonfinite updates, establishing stability only. Its first exposed F0/seed1001 paired endpoint was +0.000738 WP versus WMSE, with a component-paired 95% interval of [-0.000293, +0.001870], crossing zero. That NLL arm used a warm H256x2 parent and a 0.9 MainT3 teacher blend. It does not establish the effect of cold, labels-only NLL. The source-qualified result receipt is in the coordinating checkout at `research/campaign_2026-10-19/full_gru_tweaks_r1`; it is not vendored here.
+
+3. **Compute advantage.** The test changes the training objective without introducing teacher generation or cache preparation. It uses a three-epoch fixed endpoint and four total science fits across two matched cells. Each independent fit is single-GPU in the current trainer. This source has no DDP path, so this NLL cohort cannot use all eight B300s concurrently; the coordinating operator may schedule other authorized comparisons on the remaining devices. Do not duplicate fits merely to occupy GPUs.
+
+4. **Frozen comparison.** Two arms per cell: (A) WMSE and (B) labels-only NLL. Both set `--mean-variance-head 1`, so the final layer has the same shape and zero-initialized two-row log-variance append. Paired arms use the same fresh seed and otherwise identical recipe. Proposed cells are F0/seed1201 and F2/seed1202. Each fit uses the complete source-qualified fitting membership in its frozen outer-fold manifest, no subset, and never trains on that fold's excluded evaluation components. Use the plain 2-layer H256 GRU, linear encoder, full source sequence context, batch32, chunk2000, AdamW at LR0.001, weight decay0.01, beta2=0.999, OneCycle schedule, global gradient clip1.0, three epochs, and fixed zero-based checkpoint epoch2. Strict FP32 applies to parameters, recurrent state, activations, gradients and floating optimizer state; disable autocast and TF32 and require highest FP32 matmul precision. Both arms fit their own normalization from identical fitting membership. Labels are clipped to [-2,2]; the same scoring mask and absolute-label weights apply to both losses. No teacher, distillation cache, initializer or parent state is admitted.
+
+   The exact outer-fold manifest artifacts and hashes are not present in this source worktree, so cell membership is proposed but not fully frozen yet. Before admission, record each manifest SHA256, resolved train/evaluation component IDs and counts, raw input/data manifest and split-schema hashes, source SHA after commit, and the actual package/CUDA/driver/PyTorch environment. +# Current-source Muon scope and precision
+
+This is a source-qualified optimizer adaptation for the clean Main T3 trainer. It does not claim to recreate the historical Muon `all` implementation exactly. The full-GRU recipe must record the flags used and keep this distinction in its ancestry.
+
+The legacy default remains `--optim adamw --muon-scope rnn --muon-ortho-dtype auto`, with `--strict-muon-fp32` off. `auto` preserves the existing Newton–Schulz arithmetic: BF16 on CUDA and FP32 on CPU. Thus existing commands retain their prior optimizer behavior.
+
+The explicit `--muon-scope all` applies Muon to GRU gate matrices as separate gate blocks and every other trainable 2-D interior matrix in the standard `inp.weight` / `head.2.weight` layout. The first input projection, terminal output readout, vectors and biases stay on AdamW. The scope rejects models without that standard input/output layout. This definition is deliberately local and reviewable; it is not evidence about an unsupported historical flag.
+
+The opt-in `--muon-ortho-dtype fp32` performs every Newton–Schulz iteration in FP32 and fails if the optimizer receives a non-FP32 gradient. For the strict recipe, pass `--strict-muon-fp32`, which requires active Muon (directly or as an optimizer-switch target), `--precision fp32`, and explicit FP32 orthogonalization. On resume the canonical restore path rejects optimizer checkpoints that would downgrade the Muon group policy. The policy is stored as a boolean group field so optimizer state remains comparable and serializable without changing legacy defaults.
+
+These flags do not configure global CUDA TF32 or matmul settings. A strict training launch must independently disable TF32/autocast and record those runtime settings under the project FP32 contract.
+
+Validation here is source-only synthetic CPU work: focused grouping, dtype, update, switch and resume-policy checks; existing optimizer/dynamics/state tests; Ruff and the training structure checker. No dataset, checkpoint, GPU or quality fit was read or run.

This draft adds default-off canonical input and objective components for a matched five-arm full-GRU study: Main T3 control, causal EMA32, sparse residual features, mean/logvariance, and their combination. Common input/head topology and zero-effect warm extension preserve the initial mean/trunk function; fitting-only representation metadata travels through inference checkpoints and resumable state.
+
+The branch also imports the already reviewed strict-propensity capability byte-for-byte for clean learned ancestry. Synthetic validation and source reviews are linked from this draft. No new GRU quality improvement is claimed; the historical FP16 Main T3 score is a recipe-selection anchor, and the new study uses strict FP32. The teacher/initializer graph and old Muon semantic port remain explicit prerequisites before admitting their later fits. Actual bounded execution receipts live in the coordinating full_gru_tweaks_r1 campaign.

+# Strong GRU plus three transfer candidates
+
+The user requests a full-GRU comparison of three positive CPU-screen candidates, separately and jointly. [Authority](AUTHORITY.json) and [the pre-outcome design](DESIGN.json) fix five arms: strong control, causal signed innovation EMA32, sparse learned residual features, mean/logvariance NLL, all three. Main T3 is the strongest locally source-supported recipe family; this source port has no new GRU quality result yet.
+
+The canonical trainer now accepts an optional common467-input layout: the unchanged211 raw/event columns,128 sparse-code/residual columns, and128 causal-history columns. Inactive slots are zero, and warm-start input expansion adds zero projection columns while copying existing tensors. Feature/history arithmetic is FP32, computed over the complete sequence before TBPTT chunking. A fitting-only dictionary is selected from64 train components, with a fixed12-epoch recipe, and is frozen for the downstream GRU. External caches and embedded checkpoints bind the same fold, membership and recipe; inference and resume restore the transform without refitting.
+
+Every experimental arm has two appended zero-initialized logvariance output rows after the original mean/auxiliary rows. WMSE skips those rows. NLL applies `exp(-s)*(mean-target)^2+s`, with `s` clamped to[-4,4], the same teacher/label target as the control and original clipped-label magnitude weights. Existing auxiliary offsets and absent-option defaults remain intact. This adapts the CPU label-only NLL to the Main T3 distillation target; it is not a literal replay of that pilot.
+
+[The unchanged published strict-propensity capability import](PROPENSITY_IMPORT.json) supplies a clean scoring-mask ancestor for the strong recipe. The historical Main T3 teacher graph and its unsupported old Muon flag still require an explicit source-qualified port before those later stages are admitted. A convenient cold labels-only control is not relabeled the strongest recipe. Production-trained TL3 weights are not treated as clean outer-fold parents.
+
+[The current-source Muon port note](MUON_SCOPE_AND_PRECISION.md) defines the explicit `all` matrix scope and opt-in FP32 Newton-Schulz path. It preserves the existing `auto` default and does not claim exact reconstruction of the historical all-scope optimizer. [Its CPU test receipt](MUON_TEST_RECEIPT.json) records focused optimizer/switch tests, Ruff and training-structure checks; no model or data fit was run.
+
+Five arms cover the requested additions and the full combination; they do not identify every pairwise interaction. A complete scientific comparison requires30 paired fold/seed cells per arm (8/8/7/7), with fixed endpoints, strict FP32, clean per-fold learned ancestry and unchanged official scoring. Initial execution is bounded separately;150 final fits is a plan, not an allocation. Previously exposed folds remain exposed. Local deltas are not added to public scores.
+
+The maintenance campaign is `research/campaign_2026-10-19/full_gru_tweaks_r1/` in the coordinating checkout. Actual source/launch/resource/result receipts are indexed there. The current draft has no PR URL until creation succeeds.
+
+[Combined synthetic validation](TEST_RECEIPT.json) records21 focused tests, a strict-profile dispatch/reload check, Ruff/structure checks, and [the isolated cold-import proof](COLD_IMPORT_RECEIPT.json) for96 canonical modules/three entrypoints with zero data-read sentinel calls. [Independent representation review](INDEPENDENT_REPRESENTATION_REVIEW.json), [mean/variance cross-review](INDEPENDENT_MEAN_VARIANCE_REVIEW.json) and [review reconciliation](REVIEW_RECONCILIATION.json) distinguish final pins from one preserved earlier transform pin. The reconciliation also retains an extra legacy sentinel-test failure caused by the unchanged package API mismatch; no native submission export is claimed.
+
+[Publication validation](PUBLICATION_VALIDATION.json) binds the code commit and final source/test/import evidence, distinguishing three unchanged unavailable historical artifact links from new links.
+
+[The thin dictionary preparation CLI](DICTIONARY_JOB_REVIEW.json) uses the canonical fitting-only implementation with a create-only cache/receipt, separates source from data roots, and accepts the externally stored fold manifest. One mocked portability fixture and static/import checks pass; no real dictionary fit has run.
+

+"""Prepare one fold's shared sparse input dictionary on CPU."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import logging
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+def _project_path(root: Path, value: str, *, confined: bool = True) -> Path:
+    """Resolve a project path, optionally allowing an external manifest."""
+    path = Path(value)
+    path = (root / path if not path.is_absolute() else path).resolve()
+    if confined and not path.is_relative_to(root):
+        raise ValueError("manifest and outputs must remain under WNN_PROJECT_ROOT")
+    return path
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    """Fit or reuse the fixed train-only dictionary and write a compact receipt."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--split-manifest", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--cache", required=True, help="create-only dictionary artifact path")
+    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True, help="create-only compact JSON receipt path")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    root = Path(os.environ["WNN_PROJECT_ROOT"]).resolve()
+    manifest, cache, output = (
+        _project_path(root, args.split_manifest, confined=False),
+        _project_path(root, args.cache),
+        _project_path(root, args.output),
+    )
+    if cache.exists() or output.exists() or cache == output:
+        raise FileExistsError("cache and receipt paths must be distinct and absent")
+    os.environ["CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"] = ""
+    from wnn.training.input_representation_job import run_preparation_job
+
+    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    receipt = run_preparation_job(root, manifest, cache)
+    with output.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
+        json.dump(receipt, stream, sort_keys=True, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
+        stream.write("\n")
+        stream.flush()
+        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
+    logging.info("prepared representation cache %s", cache)
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+def family_output_slice(checkpoint_args: Mapping[str, object], n_outputs: int) -> slice:
+    """Locate family rows before optional logvariance rows in an output tensor."""
+    if checkpoint_args.get("distill_family_weight", 0.0) <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("family output export requires a checkpoint with a family head")
+    trailing_variance = 2 if checkpoint_args.get("mean_variance_head", 0) else 0
+    stop = n_outputs - trailing_variance
+    start = stop - 8

+    checkpoint_args = checkpoint.get("args", {})
+    if not isinstance(checkpoint_args, dict):
+        raise ValueError("checkpoint training arguments are missing")
+    raw_mode = checkpoint_args.get("representation_mode")
+    if raw_mode is not None and not isinstance(raw_mode, str):
+        raise ValueError("checkpoint representation mode is malformed")
+    mode = None if raw_mode in (None, "none") else raw_mode

+        payload = checkpoint.get("input_representation")
+        if payload is None:

+        return mode, deserialize_input_representation(payload, device)
+    if checkpoint.get("input_representation") is not None:
+        raise ValueError("legacy checkpoint unexpectedly contains an input representation")
+    return None, None

+"""Small semantic operations for the fixed three-teacher cleanfold cache."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Sequence
+
+import numpy as np
+
+T3_TEACHER_ORDER = (
+    "fg19_t3_h384x2_e3_s3_v1",
+    "fg19_t3_h384x2_e3_s4_v1",
+    "fg19_t3_h384x2_e3_s5_v1",
+)
+T3_HOMOGENEOUS_SCALE = np.float32(0.8125)
+
+
+def fit_prediction_positions(
+    prediction_groups: Sequence[int],
+    target_groups: Sequence[int],
+    expected_fit_groups: Sequence[int],
+) -> tuple[tuple[int, ...], np.ndarray]:
+    """Map fit-only prediction rows into canonical target-index order.
+
+    Args:
+        prediction_groups: Row-group identities in the prediction sidecar order.
+        target_groups: Row-group identities in the canonical target-index order.
+        expected_fit_groups: Exact allowed membership for this train or valid split.
+
+    Returns:
+        Canonical fit row groups and the corresponding prediction-array row indices.
+
+    Raises:
+        ValueError: If any identity list repeats, omits, or introduces a row group.
+    """
+    identities = {
+        "prediction groups": prediction_groups,
+        "target groups": target_groups,
+        "expected fit groups": expected_fit_groups,
+    }
+    for label, groups in identities.items():
+        if any(type(group) is not int for group in groups):
+            raise ValueError(f"{label} must contain integer row-group identities")
+    predicted = tuple(prediction_groups)
+    targets = tuple(target_groups)
+    expected = tuple(expected_fit_groups)
+    if len(set(predicted)) != len(predicted):
+        raise ValueError("fit-only prediction sidecar repeats a row group")
+    if len(set(targets)) != len(targets):
+        raise ValueError("canonical target index repeats a row group")
+    if len(set(expected)) != len(expected):
+        raise ValueError("expected fit membership repeats a row group")
+
+    predicted_set = set(predicted)
+    expected_set = set(expected)
+    missing = sorted(expected_set - predicted_set)
+    outer = sorted(predicted_set - expected_set)
+    if missing or outer:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"fit-only prediction membership differs: missing={missing[:8]}, outer={outer[:8]}"
+        )
+
+    target_fit_order = tuple(group for group in targets if group in expected_set)
+    if set(target_fit_order) != expected_set:
+        raise ValueError("canonical target index omits expected fitting groups")
+    prediction_position = {group: index for index, group in enumerate(predicted)}
+    positions = np.asarray(
+        [prediction_position[group] for group in target_fit_order], dtype=np.int64
+    )
+    return target_fit_order, positions
+
+
+def combine_cleanfold_t3_chunk(predictions: Sequence[np.ndarray]) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Average raw FP32 S3/S4/S5 predictions and apply the bound scale once.
+
+    Args:
+        predictions: Three raw ``(sequences, rows, 2)`` arrays in S3/S4/S5 order.
+
+    Returns:
+        A new FP32 target chunk with no clipping or per-teacher normalization.
+
+    Raises:
+        ValueError: If source count, shape, dtype, or finite values are invalid.
+    """
+    if len(predictions) != 3:
+        raise ValueError("cleanfold T3 requires predictions in exact S3/S4/S5 order")
+    shape = predictions[0].shape
+    if len(shape) != 3 or shape[-1] != 2:
+        raise ValueError("cleanfold T3 predictions must have shape (sequences, rows, 2)")
+    if any(value.shape != shape or value.dtype != np.float32 for value in predictions):
+        raise ValueError("cleanfold T3 prediction shapes and dtypes must match FP32")
+    if any(not np.isfinite(value).all() for value in predictions):
+        raise ValueError("cleanfold T3 predictions must be finite")
+
+    with np.errstate(over="ignore", invalid="ignore", divide="ignore"):
+        mean = np.add(predictions[0], predictions[1], dtype=np.float32)
+        np.add(mean, predictions[2], out=mean)
+        np.divide(mean, np.float32(3.0), out=mean)
+        np.multiply(mean, T3_HOMOGENEOUS_SCALE, out=mean)
+    if not np.isfinite(mean).all():
+        raise ValueError("cleanfold T3 FP32 mean and scale produced nonfinite values")
+    return mean

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json

+def first_profile_groups(groups: list[int] | tuple[int, ...], batch_size: int = 16) -> list[int]:
+    """Select the fixed leading fit batch without changing manifest order."""
+    selected = list(map(int, groups))
+    if batch_size <= 0 or len(selected) < batch_size:
+        raise ValueError("profile membership must contain the full fixed batch")
+    if any(group < 0 for group in selected) or len(set(selected)) != len(selected):
+        raise ValueError("profile membership must be unique nonnegative row groups")
+    return selected[:batch_size]
+
+
+def profile_record(
+    predictions: np.ndarray,
+    groups: list[int],
+    *,
+    sequence_length: int,
+    checkpoint_sha256: str,
+    source_sha256: dict[str, str],
+    split_manifest_sha256: str,
+    normalization_identity: dict[str, Any],
+    elapsed_seconds: float,
+    rss_peak_bytes: int,
+    cuda: dict[str, Any],
+    profile_contract: dict[str, Any],
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Validate finite raw main predictions and return scalar profile metadata."""
+    values = np.asarray(predictions)
+    if (
+        values.dtype != np.float32
+        or values.ndim != 3
+        or values.shape != (len(groups), sequence_length, 2)
+        or not np.isfinite(values).all()
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("profile predictions must be finite FP32 main outputs with exact geometry")
+    if not np.isfinite(elapsed_seconds) or elapsed_seconds <= 0 or rss_peak_bytes < 0:
+        raise ValueError("profile timing and RSS observations must be finite and nonnegative")
+    if not groups or len(set(groups)) != len(groups):
+        raise ValueError("profile groups must be nonempty and unique")
+    return {
+        "record_type": "PROFILE",
+        "status": "PASS",
+        "sequences": len(groups),
+        "rows": int(len(groups) * sequence_length),
+        "sequence_length": sequence_length,
+        "output_width": 2,
+        "prediction_shape": list(values.shape),
+        "prediction_dtype": str(values.dtype),
+        "finite_output_count": int(values.size),
+        "row_groups": groups,
+        "split_manifest_sha256": split_manifest_sha256,
+        "checkpoint_sha256": checkpoint_sha256,
+        "source_sha256": source_sha256,
+        "normalization_identity": normalization_identity,
+        "prediction_finite": True,
+        "prediction_min": float(values.min()),
+        "prediction_max": float(values.max()),
+        "prediction_mean": float(values.mean(dtype=np.float64)),
+        "elapsed_seconds": float(elapsed_seconds),
+        "rss_peak_bytes": int(rss_peak_bytes),
+        "cuda": cuda,
+        "profile_contract": profile_contract,
+    }
+
+
+def write_json_create_only(path: Path, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    """Write a JSON result without replacing an existing file or symlink."""
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    descriptor = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
+    try:
+        with os.fdopen(descriptor, "w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
+            json.dump(payload, stream, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
+            stream.write("\n")
+            stream.flush()
+            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
+    except Exception:
+        path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
+        raise
+
+
+def peak_rss_bytes() -> int:
+    """Return this process's high-water resident set size in bytes."""
+    value = int(resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss)
+    return value if platform.system() == "Darwin" else value * 1024

+def run_prediction_profile(
+    model: torch.nn.Module,
+    loader: Iterable[torch.Tensor],
+    predict: Callable[[torch.nn.Module, torch.Tensor, int, torch.device], np.ndarray],
+    device: torch.device,
+    groups: list[int],
+    output_path: Path,
+    *,
+    checkpoint_sha256: str,
+    source_sha256: dict[str, str],
+    split_manifest_sha256: str,
+    model_input_width: int,
+    sequence_length: int,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Run exactly one fixed full-length inference batch and write scalar telemetry."""
+    if (
+        len(groups) != 16
+        or sequence_length != 20_000
+        or model_input_width != 211
+        or torch.get_num_threads() != 1
+        or not getattr(model, "_inference_fp32", False)
+        or torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32
+        or torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32
+    ):
+        raise RuntimeError("profile execution differs from its fixed FP32 inference contract")
+
+    normalization = normalization_identity(model)
+    torch.cuda.synchronize(device)
+    torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats(device)
+    free_before, total_bytes = torch.cuda.mem_get_info(device)
+    cuda = {
+        "device": torch.cuda.get_device_name(device),
+        "total_bytes": int(total_bytes),
+        "free_before_bytes": int(free_before),
+    }
+    started = time.perf_counter()
+    predictions: np.ndarray | None = None
+    completed = 0
+    for batch in loader:
+        if predictions is not None:
+            raise RuntimeError("profile-only yielded more than its one fixed inference batch")
+        predictions = predict(model, batch, 4000, device)
+        completed += len(predictions)
+        print(
+            json.dumps(
+                {
+                    "event": "prediction_progress",
+                    "completed_sequences": completed,
+                    "total_sequences": 16,
+                }
+            ),
+            flush=True,
+        )
+    torch.cuda.synchronize(device)
+    elapsed = time.perf_counter() - started
+    if predictions is None or completed != 16:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"profile wrote {completed} of 16 sequences")
+    cuda.update(
+        {
+            "peak_allocated_bytes": int(torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(device)),
+            "peak_reserved_bytes": int(torch.cuda.max_memory_reserved(device)),
+        }
+    )
+    profile_contract = {
+        "batch_size": 16,
+        "chunk_size": 4000,
+        "membership": "first_16_fit_train_manifest_order",
+        "sequence_length": sequence_length,
+        "raw_input_width": 112,
+        "model_input_width": model_input_width,
+        "hidden_width": 384,
+        "layers": 2,
+        "output_width": 2,
+        "raw_main_outputs": True,
+        "strict_fp32": True,
+        "matmul_tf32": False,
+        "cudnn_tf32": False,
+        "autocast_enabled": False,
+        "torch_threads": torch.get_num_threads(),
+    }
+    record = profile_record(
+        predictions,
+        groups,
+        sequence_length=sequence_length,
+        checkpoint_sha256=checkpoint_sha256,
+        source_sha256=source_sha256,
+        split_manifest_sha256=split_manifest_sha256,
+        normalization_identity=normalization,
+        elapsed_seconds=elapsed,
+        rss_peak_bytes=peak_rss_bytes(),
+        cuda=cuda,
+        profile_contract=profile_contract,
+    )
+    write_json_create_only(output_path, record)
+    print("PROFILE " + json.dumps(record, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False), flush=True)
+    return record

+def _checkpoint_payload(
+    model: PropensityNet,
+    *,
+    epoch: int,
+    args: dict[str, object],
+    provenance: dict[str, object],
+) -> dict[str, object]:
+    return {
+        "model": model.state_dict(),
+        "hidden": int(args["hidden"]),
+        "n_in": int(provenance["n_in"]),
+        "epoch": epoch,
+        "args": {key: value for key, value in args.items() if key != "resume"},
+        "provenance": {
+            key: value for key, value in provenance.items() if key != "checkpoint_sha256"
+        },
+    }
+
+
+def _save_epoch_outputs(
+    *,
+    model: PropensityNet,
+    optimizer: torch.optim.Optimizer,
+    loader: DataLoader,
+    run_dir: Path,
+    args: dict[str, object],
+    provenance: dict[str, object],
+    contract: dict[str, object],
+    history: list[dict[str, object]],
+    cumulative: UpdateProgress,
+    elapsed_seconds: float,
+    next_epoch: int,
+    attempt_id: str,
+    journal: ProgressJournal,
+    on_checkpoint_saved: Callable[[int], None] | None = None,
+) -> str:
+    provenance["optimizer_progress"] = cumulative.snapshot()
+    provenance["resume_policy"] = "completed_epoch_checkpoint; restart any incomplete epoch"
+    provenance["training_state_format"] = "wnn.strict-propensity-training-state.v1"
+    provenance["scheduler"] = {"kind": "none", "reason": "fixed learning rate"}
+    provenance["fitting_seconds"] = elapsed_seconds
+    state = make_resume_state(
+        model=model,
+        optimizer=optimizer,
+        loader=loader,
+        contract=contract,
+        next_epoch=next_epoch,
+        progress=cumulative.__dict__.copy(),
+        history=history,
+        provenance=provenance,
+        elapsed_seconds=elapsed_seconds,
+        attempt_id=attempt_id,
+        event_sequence=journal.sequence,
+    )
+    state_path = run_dir / "training_state.pt"
+
+    def commit_cursor() -> None:
+        if on_checkpoint_saved is not None:
+            on_checkpoint_saved(next_epoch)
+
+    on_saved = commit_cursor if on_checkpoint_saved is not None else None
+    state_sha = save_resume_state(state, state_path, on_saved=on_saved)
+    journal.append(

+            "sha256": state_sha,

+    )

+@dataclass
+class StrictFitState:
+    """Restored training objects and provenance for one bounded fit attempt."""
+
+    attempt_id: str
+    journal: ProgressJournal
+    cumulative: UpdateProgress
+    history: list[dict[str, object]]
+    elapsed_before: float
+    next_epoch: int
+    provenance: dict[str, object]
+    contract: dict[str, object]
+
