+def prepare_strict_fit(
+    *,
+    model: PropensityNet,
+    loader: DataLoader,
+    optimizer: torch.optim.Optimizer,
+    args: dict[str, object],
+    provenance: dict[str, object],
+    normalization: dict[str, object] | None,
+    split: CampaignSplit,
+    data_root: Path,
+    source_root: Path,
+    device: torch.device,
+    resume: bool,
+    run_dir: Path,
+) -> StrictFitState:
+    """Initialize a new strict run or recover its last complete epoch."""
+    static = build_static_contract(
+        args=args,
+        provenance=provenance,
+        split=split,
+        data_root=data_root,
+        source_root=source_root,
+        loader=loader,
+        optimizer=optimizer,
+        device=device,
+    )
+    state_path = run_dir / "training_state.pt"
+    journal_path = run_dir / "progress.jsonl"
+    attempt_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
+    if resume:
+        saved = load_resume_state(state_path, static)
+        cursor = int(saved["event_sequence"])
+        journal = ProgressJournal(journal_path, resume_after=cursor)
+        recovery = journal.recovery_summary(cursor)
+        contract = saved["contract"]
+        restore_resume_state(saved, model=model, optimizer=optimizer, loader=loader)
+        cumulative = UpdateProgress(**saved["progress"])
+        history = list(saved["history"])
+        elapsed_before = float(saved["elapsed_seconds"])
+        next_epoch = int(saved["next_epoch"])
+        provenance = dict(saved["provenance"])
+        failure_history = provenance.setdefault("failure_history", [])
+        known_failures = {item.get("attempt_id") for item in failure_history}
+        for failed in recovery["failed_attempts"]:
+            if failed["attempt_id"] not in known_failures:
+                failure_history.append(failed)
+                known_failures.add(failed["attempt_id"])
+            for prior_attempt in provenance.get("training_attempts", []):
+                if prior_attempt.get("attempt_id") == failed["attempt_id"]:
+                    prior_attempt["status"] = "failed"
+        prior_outcome = journal.attempt_outcome(str(saved["attempt_id"]))
+        for prior_attempt in provenance.get("training_attempts", []):
+            if prior_attempt.get("attempt_id") != saved["attempt_id"]:
+                continue
+            if prior_outcome == "run_failed":
+                prior_attempt["status"] = "failed"
+            elif prior_outcome == "run_completed":
+                prior_attempt["status"] = "completed"
+            elif prior_attempt.get("status") == "running":
+                prior_attempt["status"] = "interrupted_recovered"
+                prior_attempt["recovered_from_epoch"] = next_epoch
+            break
+        if recovery["rolled_back_optimizer_attempts"]:
+            provenance.setdefault("recovery_history", []).append(
+                {
+                    "from_attempt_id": saved["attempt_id"],
+                    "resumed_at_epoch": next_epoch,
+                    **recovery,
+                    "policy": "rollback to completed epoch; replay incomplete epoch from saved RNG and loader state",
+                }
+            )
+    else:
+        if normalization is None:
+            raise ValueError("strict propensity needs initial fit-only normalization")
+        contract = {
+            "static": static,
+            "normalization_identity": normalization_identity(model),
+            "normalization_summary": normalization,
+        }
+        journal = ProgressJournal(journal_path)
+        cumulative = UpdateProgress()
+        history = []
+        elapsed_before = 0.0
+        next_epoch = 0
+        journal.append(attempt_id, {"event": "run_started", "next_epoch": 0}, durable=True)
+        recovery = None
+    provenance["normalization"] = contract["normalization_summary"]
+    provenance["resume_contract"] = contract
+    provenance["resume_attempt_id"] = attempt_id
+    provenance["resume_policy"] = "completed_epoch_checkpoint; replay any incomplete epoch"
+    provenance["fit_status"] = "running"
+    provenance["current_attempt_status"] = "running"
+    provenance["current_fit_attempt_id"] = attempt_id
+    provenance.setdefault("scheduler", {"kind": "none", "reason": "fixed learning rate"})
+    provenance.setdefault("training_attempts", []).append(
+        {
+            "attempt_id": attempt_id,
+            "resumed_from_epoch": next_epoch,
+            "recovery": recovery,
+            "status": "running",
+        }
+    )
+    if resume:
+        journal.append(
+            attempt_id,
+            {"event": "resume_started", "next_epoch": next_epoch, "recovery": recovery},
+            durable=True,
+        )
+        _save_epoch_outputs(
+            model=model,
+            optimizer=optimizer,
+            loader=loader,
+            run_dir=run_dir,
+            args=args,
+            provenance=provenance,
+            contract=contract,
+            history=history,
+            cumulative=cumulative,
+            elapsed_seconds=elapsed_before,
+            next_epoch=next_epoch,
+            attempt_id=attempt_id,
+            journal=journal,
+        )
+    else:
+        initial = make_resume_state(
+            model=model,
+            optimizer=optimizer,
+            loader=loader,
+            contract=contract,
+            next_epoch=0,
+            progress=cumulative.__dict__.copy(),
+            history=history,
+            provenance=provenance,
+            elapsed_seconds=0.0,
+            attempt_id=attempt_id,
+            event_sequence=journal.sequence,
+        )
+        state_sha = save_resume_state(initial, state_path)
+        journal.append(
+            attempt_id,
+            {"event": "initial_resume_checkpoint_saved", "next_epoch": 0, "sha256": state_sha},
+            durable=True,
+        )
+    atomic_write_json(run_dir / "provenance.json", provenance)
+    atomic_write_json(run_dir / "history.json", {"epochs": history})
+    return StrictFitState(
+        attempt_id=attempt_id,
+        journal=journal,
+        cumulative=cumulative,
+        history=history,
+        elapsed_before=elapsed_before,
+        next_epoch=next_epoch,
+        provenance=provenance,
+        contract=contract,
+    )

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+
+import torch
+
+from wnn.propensity import PropensityNet
+from wnn.propensity_progress import ProgressJournal, UpdateProgress
+from wnn.training.reporting import emit
+
+
+def _finite(value: torch.Tensor) -> bool:
+    return bool(torch.isfinite(value).all().item())
+
+
+def _learning_rates(optimizer: torch.optim.Optimizer) -> list[float]:
+    return [float(group["lr"]) for group in optimizer.param_groups]
+
+
+def _optimizer_state_finite(optimizer: torch.optim.Optimizer) -> bool:
+    """Reject non-finite floating point values in updated AdamW state."""
+    return all(
+        _finite(value)
+        for state in optimizer.state.values()
+        for value in state.values()
+        if isinstance(value, torch.Tensor) and value.is_floating_point()
+    )
+
+
+def _record_nonfinite(
+    *,
+    stage: str,
+    epoch: int,
+    batch: int,
+    chunk_start: int,
+    attempt_id: str,
+    journal: ProgressJournal,
+    cumulative: UpdateProgress,
+    epoch_progress: UpdateProgress,
+    optimizer_step_called: bool = False,
+) -> None:
+    cumulative.reject_nonfinite(stage)
+    epoch_progress.reject_nonfinite(stage)
+    event = {
+        "event": "optimizer_update_rejected",
+        "epoch": epoch,
+        "batch": batch,
+        "chunk_start": chunk_start,
+        "stage": stage,
+        "optimizer_step_called": optimizer_step_called,
+        "optimizer_progress": cumulative.snapshot(),
+    }
+    journal.append(attempt_id, event)
+    emit("PROPENSITY_NONFINITE", json.dumps(event, sort_keys=True), flush=True)
+
+
+def _fit_update(
+    *,
+    model: PropensityNet,
+    optimizer: torch.optim.Optimizer,
+    inputs: torch.Tensor,
+    target: torch.Tensor,
+    hidden: torch.Tensor | None,
+    chunk_start: int,
+    warmup: int,
+    epoch: int,
+    batch: int,
+    attempt_id: str,
+    journal: ProgressJournal,
+    cumulative: UpdateProgress,
+    epoch_progress: UpdateProgress,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    learning_rates = _learning_rates(optimizer)
+    for progress in (cumulative, epoch_progress):
+        progress.start(learning_rates[0])
+    journal.append(
+        attempt_id,
+        {
+            "event": "optimizer_update_started",
+            "epoch": epoch,
+            "batch": batch,
+            "chunk_start": chunk_start,
+            "learning_rates": learning_rates,
+            "optimizer_attempts": cumulative.optimizer_attempts,
+        },
+    )
+    if not _finite(inputs) or not _finite(target):
+        _record_nonfinite(
+            stage="inputs",
+            epoch=epoch,
+            batch=batch,
+            chunk_start=chunk_start,
+            attempt_id=attempt_id,
+            journal=journal,
+            cumulative=cumulative,
+            epoch_progress=epoch_progress,
+        )
+        raise FloatingPointError("strict propensity input batch is not finite")
+    with torch.autocast(inputs.device.type, enabled=False):
+        logits, next_hidden = model(inputs, hidden)
+    if not _finite(logits):
+        _record_nonfinite(
+            stage="logits",
+            epoch=epoch,
+            batch=batch,
+            chunk_start=chunk_start,
+            attempt_id=attempt_id,
+            journal=journal,
+            cumulative=cumulative,
+            epoch_progress=epoch_progress,
+        )
+        raise FloatingPointError("strict propensity logits are not finite")
+    keep = (
+        torch.arange(chunk_start, chunk_start + logits.shape[1], device=logits.device)
+        .ge(warmup)[None]
+        .expand_as(logits)
+    )
+    loss = torch.nn.functional.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(logits.float()[keep], target[keep])
+    if not _finite(loss):
+        _record_nonfinite(
+            stage="loss",
+            epoch=epoch,
+            batch=batch,
+            chunk_start=chunk_start,
+            attempt_id=attempt_id,
+            journal=journal,
+            cumulative=cumulative,
+            epoch_progress=epoch_progress,
+        )
+        raise FloatingPointError("strict propensity loss is not finite")
+    optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
+    loss.backward()
+    gradients = [parameter.grad for parameter in model.parameters() if parameter.grad is not None]
+    if any(not _finite(gradient) for gradient in gradients):
+        _record_nonfinite(
+            stage="gradients",
+            epoch=epoch,
+            batch=batch,
+            chunk_start=chunk_start,
+            attempt_id=attempt_id,
+            journal=journal,
+            cumulative=cumulative,
+            epoch_progress=epoch_progress,
+        )
+        raise FloatingPointError("strict propensity gradients are not finite")
+    if not gradients:
+        raise RuntimeError("strict propensity update has no gradients")
+    grad_norm_tensor = torch.linalg.vector_norm(
+        torch.stack([gradient.norm(2) for gradient in gradients]), 2
+    )
+    if not _finite(grad_norm_tensor):
+        _record_nonfinite(
+            stage="gradient_norm",
+            epoch=epoch,
+            batch=batch,
+            chunk_start=chunk_start,
+            attempt_id=attempt_id,
+            journal=journal,
+            cumulative=cumulative,
+            epoch_progress=epoch_progress,
+        )
+        raise FloatingPointError("strict propensity preclip gradient norm is not finite")
+    grad_norm = float(grad_norm_tensor)
+    for progress in (cumulative, epoch_progress):
+        progress.step_called()
+    optimizer.step()
+    if any(not _finite(parameter) for parameter in model.parameters()):
+        _record_nonfinite(
+            stage="weights",
+            epoch=epoch,
+            batch=batch,
+            chunk_start=chunk_start,
+            attempt_id=attempt_id,
+            journal=journal,
+            cumulative=cumulative,
+            epoch_progress=epoch_progress,
+            optimizer_step_called=True,
+        )
+        raise FloatingPointError("strict propensity weights are not finite after optimizer step")
+    if not _optimizer_state_finite(optimizer):
+        _record_nonfinite(
+            stage="optimizer_state",
+            epoch=epoch,
+            batch=batch,
+            chunk_start=chunk_start,
+            attempt_id=attempt_id,
+            journal=journal,
+            cumulative=cumulative,
+            epoch_progress=epoch_progress,
+            optimizer_step_called=True,
+        )
+        raise FloatingPointError("strict propensity optimizer state is not finite after step")

+    for progress in (cumulative, epoch_progress):
+        progress.complete(loss_value, grad_norm)
+    event = {
+        "event": "optimizer_update_completed",
+        "epoch": epoch,
+        "batch": batch,
+        "chunk_start": chunk_start,
+        "loss": loss_value,
+        "learning_rates": learning_rates,
+        "preclip_grad_norm": grad_norm,
+        "optimizer_progress": cumulative.snapshot(),
+    }
+    journal.append(attempt_id, event)
+    emit("PROPENSITY_UPDATE", json.dumps(event, sort_keys=True), flush=True)
+    return next_hidden.detach()

+
+import json

+MAX_JOURNAL_BYTES = 16_000_000
+
+
+@dataclass
+class UpdateProgress:
+    """Count attempted, accepted, and rejected strict propensity updates."""
+
+    optimizer_attempts: int = 0
+    optimizer_step_calls: int = 0
+    optimizer_completed_updates: int = 0
+    nonfinite_updates: int = 0
+    nonfinite_inputs: int = 0
+    nonfinite_logits: int = 0
+    nonfinite_losses: int = 0
+    nonfinite_gradients: int = 0
+    nonfinite_gradient_norms: int = 0
+    nonfinite_weights: int = 0
+    nonfinite_optimizer_states: int = 0
+    loss_sum: float = 0.0
+    loss_steps: int = 0
+    preclip_grad_norm_sum: float = 0.0
+    preclip_grad_norm_max: float = 0.0
+    preclip_grad_norm_steps: int = 0
+    learning_rate_first: float | None = None
+    learning_rate_last: float | None = None
+    learning_rate_min: float | None = None
+    learning_rate_max: float | None = None
+
+    def start(self, learning_rate: float) -> None:
+        """Count one update slot and track its effective learning rate."""
+        self.optimizer_attempts += 1
+        self.learning_rate_first = (
+            learning_rate if self.learning_rate_first is None else self.learning_rate_first
+        )
+        self.learning_rate_last = learning_rate
+        self.learning_rate_min = (
+            learning_rate
+            if self.learning_rate_min is None
+            else min(learning_rate, self.learning_rate_min)
+        )
+        self.learning_rate_max = (
+            learning_rate
+            if self.learning_rate_max is None
+            else max(learning_rate, self.learning_rate_max)
+        )

+        self.optimizer_completed_updates += 1
+        self.loss_sum += loss
+        self.loss_steps += 1

+        self.preclip_grad_norm_max = max(self.preclip_grad_norm_max, preclip_grad_norm)

+        self.nonfinite_updates += 1

+    def __init__(self, path: Path, *, resume_after: int | None = None) -> None:

+            self._sequence = 0
+            self._create()
+            return

+        if resume_after < 0 or resume_after > self._sequence:

+
+    def _create(self) -> None:
+        flags = os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_WRONLY | getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW", 0)

+        os.close(descriptor)
+
+    def _read(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+        flags = os.O_RDONLY | getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW", 0)
+        descriptor = os.open(self.path, flags)
+        try:
+            before = os.fstat(descriptor)
+            if not stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) or before.st_size > MAX_JOURNAL_BYTES:
+                raise ValueError("progress journal is not a bounded regular file")
+            chunks = []

+            while remaining:
+                chunk = os.read(descriptor, min(remaining, 1 << 20))
+                if not chunk:
+                    raise ValueError("progress journal shortened during read")
+                chunks.append(chunk)
+                remaining -= len(chunk)
+            after = os.fstat(descriptor)
+            path_stat = self.path.lstat()
+            if (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) != (
+                after.st_dev,
+                after.st_ino,
+                after.st_size,
+                after.st_mtime_ns,
+            ) or (path_stat.st_dev, path_stat.st_ino) != (after.st_dev, after.st_ino):

+        finally:
+            os.close(descriptor)
+        raw = b"".join(chunks)
+        events = [json.loads(line) for line in raw.splitlines()]
+        if any(
+            not isinstance(event, dict) or event.get("sequence") != index
+            for index, event in enumerate(events, 1)
+        ):

+        return events
+
+    def append(self, attempt_id: str, event: dict[str, object], *, durable: bool = False) -> int:
+        """Append a sequenced event, syncing periodically and at recovery boundaries."""
+        self._sequence += 1
+        payload = (
+            json.dumps(
+                {"sequence": self._sequence, "attempt_id": attempt_id, **event},
+                sort_keys=True,
+                separators=(",", ":"),
+                allow_nan=False,
+            ).encode("utf-8")
+            + b"\n"
+        )
+        if self.path.stat().st_size + len(payload) > MAX_JOURNAL_BYTES:
+            raise ValueError("progress journal exceeded its bounded size")
+        flags = os.O_APPEND | os.O_WRONLY | getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW", 0)
+        descriptor = os.open(self.path, flags)
+        try:
+            current = os.fstat(descriptor)
+            if not stat.S_ISREG(current.st_mode):
+                raise ValueError("progress journal is not a regular file")
+            if os.write(descriptor, payload) != len(payload):
+                raise OSError("short write to progress journal")
+            if durable or self._sequence % 64 == 0:
+                os.fsync(descriptor)
+        finally:
+            os.close(descriptor)
+        self._events.append(json.loads(payload))
+        return self._sequence
+
+    def recovery_summary(self, resume_after: int) -> dict[str, object]:
+        """Report update work after the durable epoch checkpoint that will roll back."""
+        orphaned = [event for event in self._events if event["sequence"] > resume_after]
+        updates = {

+                event.get("epoch"),
+                event.get("batch"),
+                event.get("chunk_start"),

+                event.get("attempt_id"),
+                event.get("epoch"),
+                event.get("batch"),

+    def attempt_outcome(self, attempt_id: str) -> str | None:

+        terminal = [
+            event["event"]
+            for event in self._events
+            if event.get("attempt_id") == attempt_id
+            and event.get("event") in {"run_completed", "run_failed"}
+        ]
+        return terminal[-1] if terminal else None
+
+    @property
+    def sequence(self) -> int:
+        """Return the last event sequence appended to this journal."""
+        return self._sequence

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import operator
+import os
+import platform
+import stat
+import tempfile
+from collections.abc import Callable
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+from torch.utils.data import DataLoader
+
+from wnn.propensity_recovery_validation import validate_resume_boundary
+from wnn.run_identity import normalization_identity
+from wnn.splits import CampaignSplit, file_sha256
+from wnn.training_state import (
+    atomic_save_training_state,
+    capture_rng,
+    loader_state,
+    restore_loader,
+    restore_rng,
+)
+
+STATE_FORMAT = "wnn.strict-propensity-training-state"
+STATE_VERSION = 1
+MAX_STATE_BYTES = 1_000_000_000
+
+
+def _cpu_copy(value: Any) -> Any:
+    if isinstance(value, torch.Tensor):
+        return value.detach().cpu().clone()
+    if isinstance(value, dict):
+        return {key: _cpu_copy(item) for key, item in value.items()}
+    if isinstance(value, list):
+        return [_cpu_copy(item) for item in value]
+    if isinstance(value, tuple):
+        return tuple(_cpu_copy(item) for item in value)
+    return value
+
+
+def _fit_dataset_indices(loader: DataLoader, split: CampaignSplit) -> list[int]:
+    """Require the strict loader's declared row-group order to match the split."""
+    indices = getattr(loader.dataset, "indices", None)
+    if indices is None:
+        raise ValueError("strict propensity fit dataset does not expose ordered row-group indices")
+    try:
+        actual = [operator.index(index) for index in indices]
+    except (TypeError, ValueError) as error:
+        raise ValueError("strict propensity fit dataset indices are invalid") from error
+    expected = list(map(int, split.valid_groups))
+    if actual != expected:
+        raise ValueError("strict propensity loader indices differ from ordered split.valid_groups")
+    return actual
+
+
+def build_static_contract(
+    *,
+    args: dict[str, object],
+    provenance: dict[str, object],
+    split: CampaignSplit,
+    data_root: Path,
+    source_root: Path,
+    loader: DataLoader,
+    optimizer: torch.optim.Optimizer,
+    device: torch.device,
+) -> dict[str, object]:
+    """Bind resume identity to exact code, split, data source, options and runtime."""
+    source_manifest = provenance.get("source_sha256")
+    if not isinstance(source_manifest, dict) or not source_manifest:
+        raise ValueError("strict propensity source manifest is missing")
+    for relative, expected in source_manifest.items():
+        source_path = Path(relative)
+        if source_path.is_absolute() or ".." in source_path.parts:
+            raise ValueError("strict propensity source path escapes its source root")
+        if file_sha256(source_root / source_path) != expected:
+            raise ValueError(f"strict propensity source changed: {relative}")
+    split_before = file_sha256(split.path)
+    if split_before != split.sha256:
+        raise ValueError("strict propensity split changed before contract construction")
+    split_doc = json.loads(split.path.read_text())
+    if file_sha256(split.path) != split_before:
+        raise ValueError("strict propensity split changed during contract construction")
+    fit_groups = np.asarray(split.valid_groups, dtype="<i8")
+    dataset_fit_groups = np.asarray(_fit_dataset_indices(loader, split), dtype="<i8")
+    evaluation_groups = np.asarray(split.evaluation_groups, dtype="<i8")
+    component_bytes = json.dumps(split.components, separators=(",", ":")).encode()
+    portable_path = os.environ.get("WNN_PORTABLE_DATA_MANIFEST")
+    portable = None
+    if portable_path:
+        portable_file = Path(portable_path).resolve()
+        portable = {"path": str(portable_file), "sha256": file_sha256(portable_file)}
+    options = {key: value for key, value in args.items() if key != "resume"}
+    options = json.loads(json.dumps(options, default=str, sort_keys=True))
+    runtime = {
+        "python": platform.python_version(),
+        "torch": str(torch.__version__),
+        "numpy": np.__version__,
+        "device": str(device),
+        "cuda_runtime": torch.version.cuda,
+        "cuda_device_count": torch.cuda.device_count() if torch.cuda.is_initialized() else 0,
+        "threads": torch.get_num_threads(),
+        "matmul_tf32": torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32,
+        "cudnn_tf32": torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32,
+        "cublas_workspace_config": os.environ.get("CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG"),
+        "cudnn_version": torch.backends.cudnn.version(),
+        "cudnn_deterministic": torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic,
+        "cudnn_benchmark": torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark,
+        "deterministic_algorithms": torch.are_deterministic_algorithms_enabled(),
+        "deterministic_warn_only": torch.is_deterministic_algorithms_warn_only_enabled(),
+    }
+    if device.type == "cuda":
+        properties = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(device)
+        runtime["device_name"] = properties.name
+        runtime["device_capability"] = list(torch.cuda.get_device_capability(device))
+    optimizer_defaults = json.loads(json.dumps(optimizer.defaults, default=str, sort_keys=True))
+    return {
+        "options": options,
+        "data_root": str(data_root.resolve()),
+        "source_root": str(source_root.resolve()),
+        "source_sha256": source_manifest,
+        "split": {
+            "path": str(split.path),
+            "sha256": split.sha256,
+            "fold": split.fold,
+            "n_folds": split.n_folds,
+            "sources": split_doc["sources"],
+            "fit_valid_count": len(fit_groups),
+            "fit_valid_ordered_int64_le_sha256": hashlib.sha256(fit_groups.tobytes()).hexdigest(),
+            "loader_fit_valid_count": len(dataset_fit_groups),
+            "loader_fit_valid_ordered_int64_le_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
+                dataset_fit_groups.tobytes()
+            ).hexdigest(),
+            "evaluation_count": len(evaluation_groups),
+            "evaluation_ordered_int64_le_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
+                evaluation_groups.tobytes()
+            ).hexdigest(),
+            "component_count": len(split.components),
+            "component_mapping_sha256": hashlib.sha256(component_bytes).hexdigest(),
+            "portable_registry": portable,
+        },
+        "model": {
+            "class": "PropensityNet",
+            "hidden": int(options["hidden"]),
+            "n_in": int(provenance["n_in"]),
+        },
+        "optimizer": {"class": "AdamW", "defaults": optimizer_defaults},
+        "scheduler": {"kind": "none", "reason": "fixed learning rate; no scheduler is used"},
+        "loader": loader_state(loader),
+        "runtime": runtime,
+    }
+
+
+def make_resume_state(
+    *,
+    model: torch.nn.Module,
+    optimizer: torch.optim.Optimizer,
+    loader: DataLoader,
+    contract: dict[str, object],
+    next_epoch: int,
+    progress: dict[str, object],
+    history: list[dict[str, object]],
+    provenance: dict[str, object],
+    elapsed_seconds: float,
+    attempt_id: str,
+    event_sequence: int,
+) -> dict[str, object]:
+    """Capture a portable epoch-boundary state for exact restart of the next epoch."""
+    return _cpu_copy(
+        {
+            "format": STATE_FORMAT,
+            "version": STATE_VERSION,
+            "boundary": "completed_epoch",
+            "contract": contract,
+            "next_epoch": next_epoch,
+            "model": model.state_dict(),
+            "optimizer": optimizer.state_dict(),
+            "scheduler_state": None,
+            "loader": loader_state(loader),
+            "rng": capture_rng(),
+            "progress": progress,
+            "history": history,
+            "provenance": provenance,
+            "elapsed_seconds": elapsed_seconds,
+            "attempt_id": attempt_id,
+            "event_sequence": event_sequence,
+        }
+    )
+
+
+def load_resume_state(path: Path, static_contract: dict[str, object]) -> dict[str, object]:
+    """Load and validate a bounded local strict propensity checkpoint without symlinks."""
+    flags = os.O_RDONLY | getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW", 0)
+    descriptor = os.open(path, flags)
+    try:
+        before = os.fstat(descriptor)
+        if not stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) or before.st_size > MAX_STATE_BYTES:
+            raise ValueError("strict propensity training state is not a bounded regular file")
+        with os.fdopen(os.dup(descriptor), "rb") as stream:
+            state = torch.load(stream, map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)
+        after = os.fstat(descriptor)
+        path_stat = path.lstat()
+        if (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) != (
+            after.st_dev,
+            after.st_ino,
+            after.st_size,
+            after.st_mtime_ns,
+        ) or (path_stat.st_dev, path_stat.st_ino) != (after.st_dev, after.st_ino):
+            raise ValueError("strict propensity training state changed during read")
+    finally:
+        os.close(descriptor)
+    required = {
+        "contract",
+        "next_epoch",
+        "model",
+        "optimizer",
+        "scheduler_state",
+        "loader",
+        "rng",
+        "progress",
+        "history",
+        "provenance",
+        "elapsed_seconds",
+        "attempt_id",
+        "event_sequence",
+    }
+    if (
+        not isinstance(state, dict)
+        or state.get("format") != STATE_FORMAT
+        or state.get("version") != STATE_VERSION
+        or state.get("boundary") != "completed_epoch"
+        or required - state.keys()
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("strict propensity resume state is incomplete or incompatible")
+    if (
+        not isinstance(state["contract"], dict)
+        or state["contract"].get("static") != static_contract
+        or state["scheduler_state"] is not None
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("strict propensity resume contract differs")
+    validate_resume_boundary(state, static_contract, path.parent)
+    return state
+
+
+def restore_resume_state(
+    state: dict[str, object],
+    *,
+    model: torch.nn.Module,
+    optimizer: torch.optim.Optimizer,
+    loader: DataLoader,
+) -> None:
+    """Restore model, optimizer, loader, then RNG as the last construction action."""
+    model.load_state_dict(state["model"])
+    optimizer.load_state_dict(state["optimizer"])
+    restore_loader(loader, state["loader"])
+    if normalization_identity(model) != state["contract"]["normalization_identity"]:
+        raise ValueError("strict propensity normalization buffers differ from the checkpoint")
+    restore_rng(state["rng"])
+
+
+def save_resume_state(
+    state: dict[str, object], path: Path, *, on_saved: Callable[[], None] | None = None
+) -> str:
+    """Atomically save a CPU state and return its exact file digest."""
+    atomic_save_training_state(state, path)
+    if on_saved is not None:
+        on_saved()
+    return file_sha256(path)
+
+
+def atomic_write_json(path: Path, value: dict[str, object]) -> None:
+    """Atomically replace a JSON receipt in the owned strict run directory."""
+    descriptor, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=f".{path.name}.", dir=path.parent)
+    try:
+        with os.fdopen(descriptor, "w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
+            json.dump(value, stream, indent=2, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False)
+            stream.write("\n")
+            stream.flush()
+            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
+        os.replace(temporary, path)
+    finally:
+        if os.path.exists(temporary):
+            os.unlink(temporary)

+from __future__ import annotations

+import stat
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+from wnn.splits import file_sha256

+def validate_resume_boundary(
+    state: dict[str, Any], static_contract: dict[str, Any], run_dir: Path
+) -> None:
+    """Validate an epoch cursor, including a terminal finalize-only boundary."""
+    epochs = int(static_contract["options"]["epochs"])
+    next_epoch = state.get("next_epoch")
+    if (
+        not isinstance(next_epoch, int)
+        or isinstance(next_epoch, bool)
+        or not 0 <= next_epoch <= epochs
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("strict propensity state has an invalid epoch cursor")
+    if next_epoch < epochs:
+        return
+
+    history = state.get("history")
+    if not isinstance(history, list) or [entry.get("epoch") for entry in history] != list(
+        range(epochs)
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("terminal strict propensity checkpoint lacks every committed epoch")
+    completed_per_epoch: list[int] = []
+    for entry in history:
+        progress = entry.get("optimizer_progress")
+        if not isinstance(progress, dict):
+            raise ValueError("terminal strict propensity epoch lacks update accounting")
+        completed = progress.get("optimizer_completed_updates")
+        if (
+            not isinstance(completed, int)
+            or completed <= 0
+            or progress.get("optimizer_attempts") != completed
+            or progress.get("optimizer_step_calls") != completed
+            or progress.get("nonfinite_updates") != 0
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("terminal strict propensity epoch has incomplete update accounting")
+        completed_per_epoch.append(completed)
+    if len(set(completed_per_epoch)) != 1:
+        raise ValueError("terminal strict propensity epoch update counts differ")
+    aggregate = state.get("progress")
+    expected_total = sum(completed_per_epoch)
+    if not isinstance(aggregate, dict) or any(
+        aggregate.get(key) != expected_total
+        for key in ("optimizer_attempts", "optimizer_step_calls", "optimizer_completed_updates")
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("terminal strict propensity aggregate update accounting differs")
+    if aggregate.get("nonfinite_updates") != 0:
+        raise ValueError("terminal strict propensity contains rejected updates")
+
+    provenance = state.get("provenance")
+    if (
+        not isinstance(provenance, dict)
+        or provenance.get("selected_epoch") != static_contract["options"]["checkpoint_epoch"]
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("terminal strict propensity selected checkpoint is not recorded")
+    checkpoint_hashes = provenance.get("checkpoint_sha256")
+    if not isinstance(checkpoint_hashes, dict):
+        raise ValueError("terminal strict propensity checkpoint hashes are missing")
+    expected_files = [*(f"model_ep{epoch}.pt" for epoch in range(epochs)), "model.pt"]
+    for name in expected_files:
+        path = run_dir / name
+        try:
+            info = path.lstat()
+        except FileNotFoundError as error:
+            raise ValueError(f"terminal strict propensity output is missing: {name}") from error
+        if not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) or name not in checkpoint_hashes:
+            raise ValueError(f"terminal strict propensity output is invalid: {name}")
+        if file_sha256(path) != checkpoint_hashes[name]:
+            raise ValueError(f"terminal strict propensity output changed: {name}")

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+from attrs import frozen
+
+RAW_WIDTH = 112
+CODE_WIDTH = 16
+TOP_K = 4
+SLOT_WIDTH = 128
+EXTRA_WIDTH = 2 * SLOT_WIDTH
+REPRESENTATION_MODES = ("base", "ema", "sparse", "ema_sparse")
+HALF_LIFE = 32
+EMA_ALPHA = 1.0 - 0.5 ** (1.0 / HALF_LIFE)
+
+
+@frozen
+class FittedInputRepresentation:
+    """Frozen fitting-only dictionary and normalization used by appended input slots."""
+
+    raw_mean: torch.Tensor
+    raw_scale: torch.Tensor
+    encoder_weight: torch.Tensor
+    decoder_weight: torch.Tensor
+    fit_metadata: dict[str, object]
+
+    def on_device(self, device: torch.device) -> FittedInputRepresentation:
+        """Move the small frozen representation state to its model's device."""
+        return FittedInputRepresentation(
+            raw_mean=self.raw_mean.to(device=device, dtype=torch.float32),
+            raw_scale=self.raw_scale.to(device=device, dtype=torch.float32),
+            encoder_weight=self.encoder_weight.to(device=device, dtype=torch.float32),
+            decoder_weight=self.decoder_weight.to(device=device, dtype=torch.float32),
+            fit_metadata=dict(self.fit_metadata),
+        )
+
+
+def representation_input_width(mode: str | None) -> int:
+    """Return the appended input width, preserving the legacy omitted-flag layout."""
+    if mode is None or mode == "none":
+        return 0
+    if mode not in REPRESENTATION_MODES:
+        raise ValueError(f"unknown input representation mode: {mode!r}")
+    return EXTRA_WIDTH
+
+
+@torch.no_grad()
+def build_representation_features(
+    raw: torch.Tensor, mode: str, fitted: FittedInputRepresentation
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Build the fixed 256-wide sparse/residual and causal-history suffix."""
+    with torch.autocast(device_type=raw.device.type, enabled=False):
+        return _build_representation_features_fp32(raw, mode, fitted)
+
+
+@torch.no_grad()
+def _build_representation_features_fp32(
+    raw: torch.Tensor, mode: str, fitted: FittedInputRepresentation
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Apply the frozen transform with autocast disabled and FP32 intermediates."""
+    representation_input_width(mode)
+    if raw.ndim != 3 or raw.shape[-1] != RAW_WIDTH:
+        raise ValueError("representation inputs must have shape (batch,time,112)")
+    if not torch.isfinite(raw).all().item():
+        raise FloatingPointError("nonfinite raw input to frozen representation")
+    batch_size, rows, _ = raw.shape
+    raw_fp32 = raw.to(dtype=torch.float32)
+    output = torch.empty((batch_size, rows, EXTRA_WIDTH), device=raw.device, dtype=torch.float32)
+    if mode in ("sparse", "ema_sparse"):
+        normalized = (raw_fp32 - fitted.raw_mean.view(1, 1, -1)) / fitted.raw_scale.view(1, 1, -1)
+        code = F.linear(normalized, fitted.encoder_weight)
+        order = torch.argsort(code.abs(), dim=-1, descending=True, stable=True)[..., :TOP_K]
+        mask = torch.zeros_like(code).scatter_(-1, order, 1.0)
+        code = code * mask.detach()
+        residual = normalized - F.linear(code, fitted.decoder_weight)
+        output[..., :CODE_WIDTH].copy_(code)
+        output[..., CODE_WIDTH:SLOT_WIDTH].copy_(residual)
+    elif mode == "ema":
+        output[..., :SLOT_WIDTH].zero_()
+        causal_signed_ema(
+            raw_fp32,
+            output=output[..., SLOT_WIDTH : SLOT_WIDTH + RAW_WIDTH],
+        )
+        output[..., SLOT_WIDTH + RAW_WIDTH :].zero_()
+    else:
+        output[..., :SLOT_WIDTH].zero_()
+    if mode in ("ema", "ema_sparse"):
+        if mode == "ema_sparse":
+            causal_signed_ema(output[..., :SLOT_WIDTH], output=output[..., SLOT_WIDTH:])
+    else:
+        output[..., SLOT_WIDTH:].zero_()
+    if not torch.isfinite(output).all().item():
+        raise FloatingPointError("nonfinite appended representation features")
+    return output
+
+
+@torch.no_grad()
+def causal_signed_ema(
+    values: torch.Tensor,
+    block_rows: int = 256,
+    *,
+    output: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Compute a reset-local FP32 EMA before recurrent chunking."""
+    with torch.autocast(device_type=values.device.type, enabled=False):
+        return _causal_signed_ema_fp32(values, block_rows, output)
+
+
+def _causal_signed_ema_fp32(
+    values: torch.Tensor, block_rows: int, output: torch.Tensor | None
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Evaluate a block-cumsum EMA with a FP32 carry between blocks."""
+    if values.ndim != 3 or values.shape[1] < 1 or block_rows < 1:
+        raise ValueError("EMA requires a nonempty batch/time/features tensor")
+    batch_size, row_count, width = values.shape
+    source = values.to(dtype=torch.float32)
+    if output is None:
+        result = torch.empty(
+            (batch_size, row_count, width), device=values.device, dtype=torch.float32
+        )
+    else:
+        if (
+            output.shape != (batch_size, row_count, width)
+            or output.dtype != torch.float32
+            or output.device != values.device
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("EMA output must be a matching FP32 tensor on the input device")
+        result = output
+    result.zero_()
+    alpha = torch.tensor(EMA_ALPHA, device=values.device, dtype=torch.float32)
+    beta = torch.tensor(1.0 - EMA_ALPHA, device=values.device, dtype=torch.float32)
+    previous = torch.zeros((batch_size, width), device=values.device, dtype=torch.float32)
+    for start in range(1, row_count, block_rows):
+        stop = min(start + block_rows, row_count)
+        delta = source[:, start:stop] - source[:, start - 1 : stop - 1]
+        powers = torch.pow(
+            beta,
+            torch.arange(stop - start, device=values.device, dtype=torch.float32),
+        )
+        expanded = powers.view(1, -1, 1)
+        local = alpha * expanded * torch.cumsum(delta / expanded, dim=1)
+        carried = beta * expanded * previous.unsqueeze(1)
+        local = local + carried
+        result[:, start:stop] = local
+        previous = local[:, -1]
+    if (
+        result.shape != (batch_size, row_count, width)
+        or result.dtype != torch.float32
+        or not torch.isfinite(result).all().item()
+    ):
+        raise FloatingPointError("causal EMA output is invalid")
+    return result
+
+
+def extend_input_projection_state(
+    parent_state: Mapping[str, torch.Tensor],
+    target_state: Mapping[str, torch.Tensor],
+    *,
+    parent_width: int = RAW_WIDTH + 99,
+) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Append zero-effect input columns while preserving an initialized parent function."""
+    result = dict(parent_state)
+    target_width = parent_width + EXTRA_WIDTH
+    source_weight = parent_state.get("inp.weight")
+    target_weight = target_state.get("inp.weight")
+    if source_weight is None or target_weight is None:
+        raise ValueError("representation extension requires plain `inp.weight` tensors")
+    if source_weight.ndim != 2 or target_weight.ndim != 2:
+        raise ValueError("input projection weights must be matrices")
+    if source_weight.shape[0] != target_weight.shape[0]:
+        raise ValueError("input projection output width changed during representation extension")
+    if source_weight.shape[1] == target_weight.shape[1] == target_width:
+        return result
+    if source_weight.shape[1] != parent_width or target_weight.shape[1] != target_width:
+        raise ValueError("input projection widths do not match the 211-to-467 extension")
+    expanded_weight = torch.zeros_like(target_weight)
+    expanded_weight[:, :parent_width] = source_weight.to(expanded_weight)
+    result["inp.weight"] = expanded_weight
+    for name in ("mean", "std"):
+        source = parent_state.get(name)
+        target = target_state.get(name)
+        if source is None or target is None or source.ndim != 1 or target.ndim != 1:
+            raise ValueError(f"representation extension requires one-dimensional {name!r} buffers")
+        if source.numel() != parent_width or target.numel() != target_width:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} buffer width does not match the 211-to-467 extension")
+        expanded = torch.zeros_like(target) if name == "mean" else torch.ones_like(target)
+        expanded[:parent_width] = source.to(expanded)
+        result[name] = expanded
+    return result
+
+
+def serialize_input_representation(fitted: FittedInputRepresentation) -> dict[str, object]:
+    """Create a weights-only-safe checkpoint payload for inference reconstruction."""
+    return {
+        "schema": "wnn.fitted_input_representation.v1",
+        "raw_mean": fitted.raw_mean.detach().cpu().to(torch.float32).contiguous(),
+        "raw_scale": fitted.raw_scale.detach().cpu().to(torch.float32).contiguous(),
+        "encoder_weight": fitted.encoder_weight.detach().cpu().to(torch.float32).contiguous(),
+        "decoder_weight": fitted.decoder_weight.detach().cpu().to(torch.float32).contiguous(),
+        "fit_metadata": dict(fitted.fit_metadata),
+        "state_sha256": input_representation_sha256(fitted),
+    }
+
+
+def deserialize_input_representation(
+    payload: object, device: torch.device | str = "cpu"
+) -> FittedInputRepresentation:
+    """Validate and restore the fitted transform from a model checkpoint."""
+    if (
+        not isinstance(payload, dict)
+        or payload.get("schema") != "wnn.fitted_input_representation.v1"
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("checkpoint lacks a supported fitted input representation")
+    names = ("raw_mean", "raw_scale", "encoder_weight", "decoder_weight")
+    values = {name: payload.get(name) for name in names}
+    if any(not isinstance(value, torch.Tensor) for value in values.values()):
+        raise ValueError("checkpoint representation tensors are incomplete")
+    mean, scale, encoder, decoder = (values[name] for name in names)
+    if (
+        tuple(mean.shape) != (RAW_WIDTH,)
+        or tuple(scale.shape) != (RAW_WIDTH,)
+        or tuple(encoder.shape) != (CODE_WIDTH, RAW_WIDTH)
+        or tuple(decoder.shape) != (RAW_WIDTH, CODE_WIDTH)
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("checkpoint representation tensor dimensions are invalid")
+    if any(value.dtype != torch.float32 for value in (mean, scale, encoder, decoder)):
+        raise ValueError("checkpoint representation state must use FP32 tensors")
+    if not all(torch.isfinite(value).all().item() for value in (mean, scale, encoder, decoder)):
+        raise ValueError("checkpoint representation contains nonfinite values")
+    if (scale <= 0).any().item():
+        raise ValueError("checkpoint raw input scales must be positive")
+    metadata = payload.get("fit_metadata")
+    if not isinstance(metadata, dict):
+        raise ValueError("checkpoint representation fit metadata is invalid")
+    state = FittedInputRepresentation(mean, scale, encoder, decoder, metadata).on_device(
+        torch.device(device)
+    )
+    expected = payload.get("state_sha256")
+    if expected != input_representation_sha256(state):
+        raise ValueError("checkpoint representation state digest is invalid")
+    return state
+
+
+def input_representation_sha256(fitted: FittedInputRepresentation) -> str:
+    """Hash the exact frozen dictionary and raw normalizer tensors."""
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    for name, tensor in (
+        ("raw_mean", fitted.raw_mean.to(dtype=torch.float32)),
+        ("raw_scale", fitted.raw_scale.to(dtype=torch.float32)),
+        ("encoder_weight", fitted.encoder_weight.to(dtype=torch.float32)),
+        ("decoder_weight", fitted.decoder_weight.to(dtype=torch.float32)),
+    ):
+        value = tensor.detach().cpu().contiguous()
+        digest.update(name.encode("ascii") + b"\0")
+        digest.update(str(tuple(value.shape)).encode("ascii") + b"\0")
+        digest.update(value.numpy().tobytes(order="C"))
+    return digest.hexdigest()

+"""Fixed-recipe sparse dictionary fitting for experimental input representations."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+from torch import nn
+
+from wnn.data import WARMUP
+from wnn.training.input_representation import CODE_WIDTH, RAW_WIDTH
+
+COMPONENT_SEED = 19081
+DICTIONARY_SEED = 19082
+ORDER_SEED = 19083
+DICTIONARY_EPOCHS = 12
+DICTIONARY_BATCH_SIZE = 512
+DICTIONARY_LR = 1e-3
+DICTIONARY_WEIGHT_DECAY = 1e-4
+GRAD_CLIP = 1.0
+STRIDE = 40
+FIT_COMPONENTS = 64
+ARTIFACT_SCHEMA = "wnn.input_representation_fit.v1"
+REPRESENTATION_RECIPE = {
+    "version": 1,
+    "component_selection_seed": COMPONENT_SEED,
+    "fit_components": FIT_COMPONENTS,
+    "row_stride": STRIDE,
+    "warmup_rows": WARMUP,
+    "dictionary_initialization_seed": DICTIONARY_SEED,
+    "epoch_order_seed": ORDER_SEED,
+    "dictionary_epochs": DICTIONARY_EPOCHS,
+    "batch_size": DICTIONARY_BATCH_SIZE,
+    "optimizer": "AdamW",
+    "learning_rate": DICTIONARY_LR,
+    "weight_decay": DICTIONARY_WEIGHT_DECAY,
+    "gradient_clip_norm": GRAD_CLIP,
+    "raw_width": RAW_WIDTH,
+    "code_width": CODE_WIDTH,
+    "top_k": 4,
+    "dictionary_dtype": "float32",
+    "normalizer_accumulation": "float64_cpu",
+    "normalizer_storage_and_application": "float32",
+}
+
+
+class _SparseDictionary(nn.Module):
+    """Bias-free 112→16→112 tied-start dictionary with stable signed top-four codes."""
+
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.encoder_weight = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(CODE_WIDTH, RAW_WIDTH))
+        self.decoder_weight = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(RAW_WIDTH, CODE_WIDTH))
+
+    def forward(self, inputs: torch.Tensor) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        """Return stable top-four signed codes and their linear reconstruction."""
+        code = F.linear(inputs, self.encoder_weight)
+        selected = torch.argsort(code.abs(), dim=1, descending=True, stable=True)[:, :4]
+        mask = torch.zeros_like(code).scatter_(1, selected, 1.0)
+        code = code * mask.detach()
+        return code, F.linear(code, self.decoder_weight)
+
+    @torch.no_grad()
+    def normalize_decoder_columns(self) -> None:
+        """Project dictionary columns to unit length after each fixed update."""
+        norms = torch.linalg.vector_norm(self.decoder_weight, dim=0)
+        if not torch.isfinite(norms).all().item() or (norms <= 1e-12).any().item():
+            raise FloatingPointError("dictionary decoder has a nonfinite or collapsed column")
+        self.decoder_weight.div_(norms.unsqueeze(0))
+
+
+def representation_recipe_sha256() -> str:
+    """Hash the fixed fold dictionary recipe accepted by cache and checkpoint loads."""
+    encoded = json.dumps(REPRESENTATION_RECIPE, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
+    return hashlib.sha256(encoded.encode("ascii")).hexdigest()
+
+
+def raw_normalizer(values: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
+    """Compute fit-only float64 population moments in bounded row chunks."""
+    if values.ndim != 2 or values.shape[1] != RAW_WIDTH or not np.isfinite(values).all():
+        raise ValueError("raw normalizer expects finite fit rows shaped (N,112)")
+    total = np.zeros(RAW_WIDTH, dtype=np.float64)
+    total_sq = np.zeros(RAW_WIDTH, dtype=np.float64)
+    for start in range(0, len(values), 16_000):
+        block = values[start : start + 16_000].astype(np.float64, copy=False)
+        total += block.sum(axis=0, dtype=np.float64)
+        total_sq += np.square(block).sum(axis=0, dtype=np.float64)
+    mean = total / len(values)
+    variance = np.maximum(total_sq / len(values) - np.square(mean), 0.0)
+    scale = np.maximum(np.sqrt(variance), 1e-6)
+    return mean, scale
+
+
+def _initialize_dictionary(seed: int) -> _SparseDictionary:
+    """Initialize encoder/decoder from one normalized Gaussian decoder draw."""
+    with torch.random.fork_rng(devices=[]):
+        torch.manual_seed(seed)
+        model = _SparseDictionary()
+    generator = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(seed)
+    decoder = torch.randn((RAW_WIDTH, CODE_WIDTH), generator=generator)
+    decoder /= torch.linalg.vector_norm(decoder, dim=0, keepdim=True)
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        model.encoder_weight.copy_(decoder.T)
+        model.decoder_weight.copy_(decoder)
+    return model
+
+
+def fit_dictionary(values: np.ndarray) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, dict[str, object]]:
+    """Fit a frozen top-four dictionary for the fixed twelve-epoch recipe."""
+    inputs = torch.from_numpy(np.ascontiguousarray(values, dtype=np.float32))
+    model = _initialize_dictionary(DICTIONARY_SEED)
+    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(
+        model.parameters(), lr=DICTIONARY_LR, weight_decay=DICTIONARY_WEIGHT_DECAY
+    )
+    attempted = 0
+    losses: list[float] = []
+    for epoch in range(DICTIONARY_EPOCHS):
+        generator = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(ORDER_SEED + epoch)
+        order = torch.randperm(len(inputs), generator=generator)
+        for start in range(0, len(order), DICTIONARY_BATCH_SIZE):
+            batch = inputs.index_select(0, order[start : start + DICTIONARY_BATCH_SIZE])
+            optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
+            _, reconstruction = model(batch)
+            loss = torch.mean((reconstruction - batch).square())
+            if not torch.isfinite(loss).item():
+                raise FloatingPointError("nonfinite dictionary reconstruction loss")
+            loss.backward()
+            if any(
+                parameter.grad is not None and not torch.isfinite(parameter.grad).all().item()
+                for parameter in model.parameters()
+            ):
+                raise FloatingPointError("nonfinite dictionary gradient")

+def select_fit_members(
+    train_groups: np.ndarray, split: CampaignSplit, count: int = FIT_COMPONENTS
+) -> list[dict[str, int | str]]:
+    """Seed-select one lowest train row-group from each fit-only component."""
+    groups = np.asarray(train_groups, dtype=np.int64)
+    if groups.ndim != 1 or groups.size == 0 or len(set(groups.tolist())) != groups.size:
+        raise ValueError("dictionary training groups must be unique and one-dimensional")
+    split.assert_fit_groups(groups, ())
+    allowed = set(map(int, groups.tolist()))
+    by_component: dict[int, list[int]] = defaultdict(list)
+    for source, group, component in split.components:
+        if source == "train" and int(group) in allowed:
+            by_component[int(component)].append(int(group))
+    components = np.asarray(sorted(by_component), dtype=np.int64)
+    if count < 1 or components.size < count:
+        raise ValueError(f"dictionary fitting needs {count} fit-only train components")
+    rng = np.random.default_rng(COMPONENT_SEED)
+    chosen = np.sort(rng.choice(components, size=count, replace=False))
+    return [
+        {"source": "train", "group": min(by_component[int(component)]), "component": int(component)}
+        for component in chosen
+    ]
+
+
+def _member_identity(members: list[dict[str, int | str]]) -> str:
+    encoded = json.dumps(members, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=True)
+    return hashlib.sha256(encoded.encode("ascii")).hexdigest()
+
+
+def validate_fitted_representation(
+    fitted: FittedInputRepresentation,
+    split_sha256: str,
+    members: list[dict[str, int | str]],
+) -> None:
+    """Fail closed if embedded transform metadata differs from the fixed fold recipe."""
+    metadata = fitted.fit_metadata
+    if (
+        metadata.get("split_manifest_sha256") != split_sha256
+        or metadata.get("fit_members") != members
+        or metadata.get("fit_members_sha256") != _member_identity(members)
+        or metadata.get("recipe") != REPRESENTATION_RECIPE
+        or metadata.get("recipe_sha256") != representation_recipe_sha256()
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("fitted representation metadata differs from the fixed fold recipe")
+    if any(
+        value.dtype != torch.float32
+        for value in (
+            fitted.raw_mean,
+            fitted.raw_scale,
+            fitted.encoder_weight,
+            fitted.decoder_weight,
+        )
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("fitted representation tensors must use FP32 storage")
+
+
+def _fit_rows(members: list[dict[str, int | str]], environment: TrainingEnvironment) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Read complete fitting sequences, retaining only post-warmup stride-40 rows."""
+    row_indices = np.arange(0, SEQUENCE_LENGTH, STRIDE, dtype=np.int64)
+    row_indices = row_indices[row_indices >= WARMUP]
+    expected_rows = len(members) * len(row_indices)
+    matrix = np.empty((expected_rows, N_FEATURES), dtype=np.float32)
+    source = environment.sequence_file(environment.root / "datasets" / "train.parquet")
+    offset = 0
+    for member in members:
+        sequence = source.read(int(member["group"]), targets=False, mask=False)
+        features = np.asarray(sequence.features)
+        if features.shape != (SEQUENCE_LENGTH, N_FEATURES) or features.dtype != np.float32:
+            raise ValueError("dictionary source sequence does not match canonical F0 schema")
+        selected = features[row_indices]
+        if not np.isfinite(selected).all():
+            raise ValueError("dictionary fitting inputs contain nonfinite raw features")
+        matrix[offset : offset + len(selected)] = selected
+        offset += len(selected)
+    if offset != expected_rows:
+        raise RuntimeError("dictionary fitting row count changed during full-sequence extraction")
+    return matrix
+
+
+def _artifact_payload(
+    fitted: FittedInputRepresentation,
+    split_sha256: str,
+    members: list[dict[str, int | str]],
+) -> dict[str, object]:
+    """Bind dictionary tensors to exact fit membership and fixed recipe metadata."""
+    return {
+        "schema": ARTIFACT_SCHEMA,
+        "split_manifest_sha256": split_sha256,
+        "fit_members": members,
+        "fit_members_sha256": _member_identity(members),
+        "recipe": REPRESENTATION_RECIPE,
+        "recipe_sha256": representation_recipe_sha256(),
+        "representation": serialize_input_representation(fitted),
+    }
+
+
+def _load_artifact(
+    path: Path,
+    split_sha256: str,
+    members: list[dict[str, int | str]],
+    device: torch.device,
+) -> FittedInputRepresentation:
+    """Load only a matching same-fold fit artifact with safe tensor deserialization."""
+    payload = torch.load(path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
+    if (
+        not isinstance(payload, dict)
+        or payload.get("schema") != ARTIFACT_SCHEMA
+        or payload.get("split_manifest_sha256") != split_sha256
+        or payload.get("fit_members") != members
+        or payload.get("fit_members_sha256") != _member_identity(members)
+        or payload.get("recipe") != REPRESENTATION_RECIPE
+        or payload.get("recipe_sha256") != representation_recipe_sha256()
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("representation cache does not match current fold fitting membership")
+    representation = deserialize_input_representation(payload.get("representation"), device)
+    validate_fitted_representation(representation, split_sha256, members)
+    return representation
+
+
+def prepare_input_representation(
+    train_groups: np.ndarray,
+    split: CampaignSplit | None,
+    environment: TrainingEnvironment,
+    device: torch.device,
+    *,
+    cache_path: Path | None,
+    output_path: Path,
+) -> FittedInputRepresentation:
+    """Load the shared fold dictionary or fit it from selected train groups only."""
+    if split is None:
+        raise ValueError("experimental representations require a source-qualified campaign split")
+    members = select_fit_members(train_groups, split)
+    if cache_path is not None:
+        cache_path = cache_path.expanduser().resolve()
+        if cache_path.is_file():
+            return _load_artifact(cache_path, split.sha256, members, device)
+        destination = cache_path
+    else:
+        destination = output_path / "input_representation.pt"

+        "fit_members_sha256": _member_identity(members),
+        "split_manifest_sha256": split.sha256,
+        "recipe": REPRESENTATION_RECIPE,
+        "recipe_sha256": representation_recipe_sha256(),
+        "component_selection_seed": COMPONENT_SEED,
+        "component_selection": "uniform_without_replacement_sorted_fit_train_components; lowest_train_row_group_per_component",
+        "fit_rows": "all train rows at canonical stride40 with row_index>=99; train source has no scored mask",
+        "fit_row_count": int(len(raw)),
+        "raw_normalizer": "float64_population_moments_fit_rows_only; std_floor=1e-6; accumulated in 16000-row blocks; stored_buffers_and_application_fp32",
+        "raw_mean": mean.tolist(),
+        "raw_scale": scale.tolist(),

+    }
+    fitted_cpu = FittedInputRepresentation(
+        raw_mean=torch.from_numpy(mean_fp32),
+        raw_scale=torch.from_numpy(scale_fp32),
+        encoder_weight=encoder,
+        decoder_weight=decoder,
+        fit_metadata=metadata,
+    )
+    payload = _artifact_payload(fitted_cpu, split.sha256, members)
+    destination = destination.expanduser().resolve()
+    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    with destination.open("xb") as stream:
+        torch.save(payload, stream)
+        stream.flush()
+    return fitted_cpu.on_device(device)

+"""Bounded orchestration and metadata for the canonical representation fitter."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+import signal
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+def run_preparation_job(root: Path, manifest: Path, cache: Path) -> dict[str, object]:
+    """Prepare the create-only shared cache and return compact provenance metadata."""
+    import numpy as np
+    import torch
+
+    from wnn.splits import file_sha256, load_campaign_split
+    from wnn.training.environment import TrainingEnvironment
+    from wnn.training.input_representation import input_representation_sha256
+    from wnn.training.input_representation_dictionary import (
+        REPRESENTATION_RECIPE,
+        representation_recipe_sha256,
+    )
+    from wnn.training.input_representation_fit import prepare_input_representation
+
+    root, manifest, cache = root.resolve(), manifest.resolve(), cache.resolve()
+    if not cache.is_relative_to(root):
+        raise ValueError("dictionary cache must remain under the data root")
+    if cache.exists():
+        raise FileExistsError(f"dictionary cache already exists: {cache}")
+    cache.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    torch.set_num_threads(1)
+    torch.set_num_interop_threads(1)
+    environment = TrainingEnvironment(root=root)
+    signal.alarm(600)
+    try:
+        split = load_campaign_split(manifest, root)
+        fitted = prepare_input_representation(
+            np.asarray(split.train_groups),
+            split,
+            environment,
+            torch.device("cpu"),
+            cache_path=cache,
+            output_path=cache.parent,
+        )
+    finally:
+        signal.alarm(0)
+    metadata = fitted.fit_metadata
+    source_root = Path(environment.source_root).resolve()
+    source_files = (
+        "src/wnn/data.py",
+        "src/wnn/splits.py",
+        "src/wnn/training/environment.py",
+        "src/wnn/training/input_representation.py",
+        "src/wnn/training/input_representation_dictionary.py",
+        "src/wnn/training/input_representation_fit.py",
+        "src/wnn/training/input_representation_job.py",
+        "scripts/fit_input_representation.py",
+    )
+    return {
+        "schema": "wnn.input_representation_preparation.v1",
+        "split_manifest_sha256": split.sha256,
+        "source_root": str(source_root),
+        "data_root": str(root),
+        "source_sha256": {name: file_sha256(source_root / name) for name in source_files},
+        "recipe": REPRESENTATION_RECIPE,
+        "recipe_sha256": representation_recipe_sha256(),
+        "membership": {
+            "members": metadata["fit_members"],
+            "sha256": metadata["fit_members_sha256"],
+        },
+        "counts": {
+            "fit_sequences": len(metadata["fit_members"]),
+            "fit_rows": metadata["fit_row_count"],
+            "successful_updates": metadata["dictionary_training"][
+                "attempted_and_successful_updates"
+            ],
+        },
+        "representation_sha256": input_representation_sha256(fitted),
+        "cache": {"path": str(cache), "sha256": file_sha256(cache), "bytes": cache.stat().st_size},
+        "runtime": {
+            "device": "cpu",
+            "torch_threads": torch.get_num_threads(),
+            "cuda_visible_devices": os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"),
+        },
+    }

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+LOG_VARIANCE_MIN = -4.0
+LOG_VARIANCE_MAX = 4.0
+LOG_VARIANCE_OUTPUTS = 2
+
+
+def configuration_error(args: argparse.Namespace, controlled_loss: bool) -> str | None:
+    """Return why the opt-in mean/logvariance recipe is incompatible with this run."""
+    enabled = bool(args.mean_variance_head)
+    objective = args.mean_variance_objective
+    target_source = getattr(args, "mean_variance_target_source", "main_t3_blend")
+    if target_source not in ("main_t3_blend", "labels"):
+        return "--mean-variance-target-source must be main_t3_blend or labels"
+    if target_source == "labels" and objective != "nll":
+        return "--mean-variance-target-source labels requires --mean-variance-objective nll"
+    if objective == "nll" and not enabled:
+        return "--mean-variance-objective nll requires --mean-variance-head 1"
+    if not enabled:
+        return None
+    if args.arch != "gru" or args.cell != "gru" or args.enc != "linear":
+        return "--mean-variance-head requires the plain GRU with a linear input encoder"
+    if args.precision != "fp32" or args.qat != "none" or args.recurrent_rank:
+        return "--mean-variance-head requires dense strict FP32 without QAT"
+    if args.loss != "wmse" or args.loss_norm != "chunk":
+        return "--mean-variance-head supports only chunk-normalized --loss wmse"
+    if controlled_loss or args.td_alpha or args.ema_teacher or args.eval_ema or args.swa_frac:
+        return "--mean-variance-head does not support controlled, TD, EMA, or SWA objectives"
+    if objective == "nll":
+        has_teacher = bool(
+            args.distill or args.distill_cache_root or args.final_distill_initializer
+        )
+        if target_source == "labels" and (has_teacher or args.distill_family_weight):
+            return "label-only mean/logvariance NLL forbids teacher targets and family distillation"
+        if target_source == "main_t3_blend" and not has_teacher:
+            return "the mean/logvariance NLL requires the fixed MainT3 blended teacher target"
+        if target_source == "main_t3_blend" and (
+            args.distill_alpha != 0.9
+            or args.distill_alpha_far is not None
+            or args.distill_boot_h != 0
+            or args.distill_reanchor != 0.0
+            or args.distill_cache_scale != 1.0
+        ):
+            return "the mean/logvariance NLL requires the fixed 0.9 teacher / 0.1 label target"
+    return None
+
+
+def weighted_label_diagonal_gaussian_nll(
+    mean: torch.Tensor,
+    labels: torch.Tensor,
+    log_variance: torch.Tensor,
+    valid: torch.Tensor,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Compute canonical clipped-label weighted NLL without any teacher target."""
+    target = labels.float().clamp(-2, 2)
+    weights = target.abs() * valid.float()[..., None]
+    return weighted_diagonal_gaussian_nll(mean, target, log_variance, weights)
+
+
+def weighted_diagonal_gaussian_nll(
+    mean: torch.Tensor,
+    target: torch.Tensor,
+    log_variance: torch.Tensor,
+    weights: torch.Tensor,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Compute weighted Gaussian NLL in the canonical two-target clipped-weight scale."""
+    if (
+        mean.shape != target.shape
+        or mean.shape != log_variance.shape
+        or mean.shape != weights.shape
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("mean, target, logvariance and weights must have identical shapes")
+    mean = mean.float()
+    target = target.float()
+    log_variance = log_variance.float().clamp(LOG_VARIANCE_MIN, LOG_VARIANCE_MAX)
+    weights = weights.float()
+    residual_squared = (mean - target).square()
+    terms = torch.exp(-log_variance) * residual_squared + log_variance
+    return (weights * terms).sum() / weights.sum().clamp_min(1e-8)
+
+
+def append_log_variance_output_head(model: nn.Module) -> nn.Module:
+    """Append two zero-initialized output rows without changing existing model outputs."""
+    head = getattr(model, "head", None)
+    if not isinstance(head, nn.Sequential) or not isinstance(head[-1], nn.Linear):
+        raise ValueError("mean/logvariance output requires a sequential linear readout head")
+    output = head[-1]
+    if output.bias is None:
+        raise ValueError("mean/logvariance output requires a biased readout layer")
+    old_width = output.out_features
+    device = output.weight.device
+    with torch.random.fork_rng(devices=[]):
+        expanded = nn.Linear(
+            output.in_features,
+            old_width + LOG_VARIANCE_OUTPUTS,
+            bias=True,
+            device="cpu",
+            dtype=output.weight.dtype,
+        )
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        expanded.weight[:old_width].copy_(output.weight.detach().to("cpu"))
+        expanded.bias[:old_width].copy_(output.bias.detach().to("cpu"))
+        expanded.weight[old_width:].zero_()
+        expanded.bias[old_width:].zero_()
+    head[-1] = expanded.to(device=device)
+    return model
+
+
+def extend_mean_variance_state(
+    parent_state: Mapping[str, torch.Tensor],
+    initialized_state: Mapping[str, torch.Tensor],
+    *,
+    family_outputs: int = 0,
+) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Copy parent tensors and preserve initialized family plus zero logvariance rows."""
+    if parent_state.keys() != initialized_state.keys():
+        raise ValueError("parent and student checkpoint tensor names differ")
+    expected_extra = family_outputs + LOG_VARIANCE_OUTPUTS
+    if family_outputs not in (0, 8):
+        raise ValueError("only the existing eight-output family extension is supported")
+    merged = {name: value.clone() for name, value in initialized_state.items()}
+    for name, parent_value in parent_state.items():
+        student_value = initialized_state[name]
+        if name in ("head.2.weight", "head.2.bias"):
+            if (
+                parent_value.ndim != student_value.ndim
+                or parent_value.shape[0] < 2
+                or student_value.shape[0] != parent_value.shape[0] + expected_extra
+                or parent_value.shape[1:] != student_value.shape[1:]
+            ):
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "student output head must append family rows and two logvariance rows"

+def muon_precision_error(args: argparse.Namespace) -> str | None:
+    """Validate explicit Muon orthogonalization and strict-FP32 recipe flags."""
+    ortho_dtype = getattr(args, "muon_ortho_dtype", "auto")
+    if ortho_dtype not in {"auto", "fp32"}:
+        return "--muon-ortho-dtype must be auto or fp32"
+
+    optim = getattr(args, "optim", "adamw")
+    switch_target = (getattr(args, "optim_switch", "") or "").partition(":")[2]
+    muon_active = optim == "muon" or switch_target == "muon"
+    strict = bool(getattr(args, "strict_muon_fp32", False))
+
+    if not muon_active:
+        if strict:
+            return "--strict-muon-fp32 requires --optim muon or an --optim-switch target of muon"
+        if ortho_dtype != "auto":
+            return "--muon-ortho-dtype applies only when Muon is active"
+        return None
+
+    if strict and getattr(args, "precision", None) != "fp32":
+        return "--strict-muon-fp32 requires --precision fp32"
+    if strict and ortho_dtype != "fp32":
+        return "--strict-muon-fp32 requires --muon-ortho-dtype fp32"
+    return None
+
+
+def muon_resume_policy_error(
+    args: argparse.Namespace,
+    current_groups: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
+    saved_optimizer: Mapping[str, Any],
+) -> str | None:
+    """Reject a strict-FP32 resume checkpoint that would downgrade Muon NS arithmetic."""
+    if not bool(getattr(args, "strict_muon_fp32", False)):
+        return None
+    saved_groups = saved_optimizer.get("param_groups")
+    if not isinstance(saved_groups, list) or len(saved_groups) != len(current_groups):
+        return "strict Muon resume optimizer groups are missing or changed"
+    for index, (current, saved) in enumerate(zip(current_groups, saved_groups, strict=True)):
+        if not isinstance(saved, Mapping):
+            return "strict Muon resume optimizer group metadata is malformed"
+        planned_muon = bool(current.get("muon", False)) or bool(current.get("switch_muon", False))
+        if planned_muon and (
+            current.get("muon_fp32_ortho") is not True or saved.get("muon_fp32_ortho") is not True
+        ):
+            return (
+                "strict Muon resume requires FP32 orthogonalization in optimizer group "
+                f"{index}; checkpoint policy differs"
+            )
+    return None

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
